a: May tama ka mechayyeyvi rabbanan? illema mishshum dimheman — veha tere bealma, deaf al gav deka machchish lehu inhu — mehemni, veka patri rabbanan. ella lav, mishshum deishtik — ushetika kehodaa damya.
Ella sevara hi, midde dehave achaticha safek shel chelev safek shel shumman, vaata ed echad veamar: bari li, deshumman hu — dimheman.
Mi dame? hatam la ittachzak issura, hacha ittachzak issura deeshet ish, veen davar shebbeerva pachot mishshenayim!

Ha la damya ella lachaticha devadday chelev, vaata ed echad veamar: bari li deshumman hava — dela meheman! mi dame? hatam, afillu atu be mea la mehemni. hacha, kevan dechi atu be tere mehemni — chad name lehemneh, midde dehave attevel, hekdesh, vekuvnnamot.
Hay tevel, hechi dame? i dideh — mishshum divyado letakkeno. ella deacher, may kasavar:
I ka savar: torem mishshello al shel chavero eno tzarich daat bealim — mishshum divyado letakkeno, vei kasavar: tzarich daat bealim, veamar: ana yadana beh dimtakkan, hi gufa menalan?
Hekdesh name, i kedushshat damim — mishshum divyado lifdoto. i kedushshat hagguf, i dideh — mishshum divyado leitteshole aleh. ella deacher, veamar: yadana beh deitteshil mareh aleh, hi gufa menalan?

Kuvnnamot name, i kasavar: yesh meila bekuvnnamot, ukedushshat damim nachata lehu — mishshum divyado lifdoto, vei kasavar: en meila bekuvnnamot, veissur bealma hu derachev lehu akkatpeh, i dideh — mishshum divyado leitteshole aleh,
Ella deacher, veamar: ana yadana deitteshil mareh aleh — hi gufa menalan?
Amar rabbi zera: mittoch chomer shehechmarta aleha besofah — hekalta aleha battechilla. la laychmayr vela laykkel!
Mishshum igguna akkilu ba rabbanan.

Tetze mizze umizze vechulei. amar rav: lo shanu ella shennisset beed echad, aval nisset al pi shene edim — lo tetze. machachu aleh bemareva: ata gavra vekae, veat amrat lo tetze? la tzericha, dela yadinan leh.

I dela yadinan leh, beed echad ammay tetze? la tzericha, daato be tere veamri: anan havenan bahadeh mikki nefak vead hasheta, veattun hu dela yaditu leh, dichtiv: "vayyakker yosef et echav vehem lo hikkiruhu", veamar rav chisda: melammed sheyyatza belo chatimat zakan, uva bachatimat zakan.
Sof sof tere utere ninhu,
b: Vehabba aleha beasham taluy kae! amar rav sheshet: kegon shennisset leechad meedeha.

Hi gufa beasham taluy kayyma! beomeret "bari li". i hachi, may lememra? afillu rabbi menachem berabbi yose la kaamar ella keshebbau edim veachar kach nisset, aval nisset veachar kach bau edim — la amar.

Detanya: shenayim omrim "met" ushenayim omrim "la met", shenayim omrim "nitgarsha" ushenayim omrim "lo nitgarsha" — hare zo lo tinnase, veim nisset — lo tetze. rabbi menachem berabbi yose amar: tetze. amar rabbi menachem berabbi yose: emat ani omer tetze? bizman shebbau edim veachar kach nisset. aval nisset veachar kach bau edim — hare zo lo tetze!

Ki kaamar rav name, bizman shebbau edim veachar kach nisset. leappoke midderabbi menachem berabbi yose. veikka deamar: tama denisset veachar kach bau edim, aval bau edim veachar kach nisset — tetze. keman — kerabbi menachem berabbi yose.
Metiv rava: minnayin sheim lo ratza — dofno, talmud lomar: "vekiddashto", beal korcho.
Hechi dame, illema dela nisset leechad meedeha velo kaamra "bari li", tzericha lememar dedofno? ella lav, denisset leechad meedeha, vekaamra "bari li", vekatane dofno. alma, mappekinan la minneh!
Issur kehunna shane. veibbaet ema: may dofno — dofno beedim. veibbaet ema: keshebbau edim veachar kach nisset, verabbi menachem berabbi yose hi.
Rav ashe omer: may "lo tetze" dekaamar rav — lo tetze mehetterah harishon.
Ha amra rav chada zimna, ditnan: nisset shello birshut — mutteret lachzor lo. veamar rav huna amar rav: hachi hilcheta! chada mikkelala dachaverta ittemar.
Amar shemuel: lo shanu ella shello machchashto, aval machchashto — lo tetze. bemay askinan? ilema beve tere, ki machchasha leh may have! ella bechad, tama demachchashto, ha shatka — tetze.
Vehaamar ulla: kol makom sheheemina tora ed echad, hare kan shenayim, veen devarav shel echad bimkom shenayim! hacha bemay askinan — bifsule edut, vechidrabbi nechemya.
Detanya, rabbi nechemya omer: kol makom sheheemina tora ed echad — hallech achar rov deot. veasu shete nashim beish echad kishne anashim beish echad.
Veibbaet ema: kol hecha daata ed echad kasher meikkara, afillu mea nashim — keed echad damyayn. hacha bemay askinan, kegon deatya ishsha meikkara.

Vetartza lidrabbi nechemya hachi: rabbi nechemya omer: kol makom sheheemina tora ed echad — hallech achar rov deot, veasu shete nashim beishsha achat — kishne anashim beish echad aval shete nashim beish echad — kefalga ufalga dame.
Tzericha get mizze umizze. bishlama merishon tive get, ella mishsheni ammay? zenut bealma hu!

Amar rav huna: gezera shemma yomru gerash ze venasa ze, venimtzet eshet ish yotza bela get. i hachi, sefa dekatane: amru lah "met balich" venitkaddesha, veachar kach ba balah — mutteret lachzor lo. hatam name, nema: gerash ze vekiddesh ze, venimtzet eshet ish yotza shello bagget!
Leolam baaya get. i hachi, nimtza ze machazir gerushato mishshennitarsa! kerabbi yose ben kippar, deamar: min hannissuin — asura, min haerusin — mutteret.
Ha middekatane sefa: af al pi

a: Shennatan lah acharon get — lo pesalah min hakkehunna, mikkelal dela baaya get. dei baaya get, ammay lo pesalah min hakkehunna? ella sefa, amri: kiddushe taut havo.
Resha name, amri: nissue taut havo? kansuha rabbanan. sefa name liknesuha! resha, daavada issura — kansuha. sefa, dela avada issura — la kansuha rabbanan.
En lah ketubba. may tama takkinu la rabbanan ketubba, kede shello tehe kalla beenav lehotziah — ha tehe kalla beenav lehotziah.
En lah perot velo mezonot velo belaot. tenay ketubba — kichtubba dame.
Natla mizze umizze. peshita! mahu detema: kevan detafsa la mappekinan minna, ka mashma lan.

Havvalad mamzer. tenan hatam: en tormin min hattame al hattahor, veim taram, beshogeg — terumato teruma, bemezid — lo asa velo kelum. may lo asa velo kelum? amar rav chisda: lo asa velo kelum kol ikkar, daafillu hahuy geriva hadar letivleh.
Rav natan berabbi oshaya amar: lo asa velo chelum — letakken et hashshirayim, aval teruma have. rav chisda la amar kerav natan berabbi oshaya, dei amrat have teruma, zimnin defasha vela mafresh.
May shena meha ditnan: hattorem kishshut venimtzet mara, avattiach venimtzet saruach — teruma, veyachazor veyitrom! shogeg ammezid karamet? shogeg — la avad issura, mezid — kaaved issura.
Uremi shogeg ashshogeg — hacha katane: beshogeg terumato teruma, hatam katane: teruma, veyachzor veyitrom!
Hatam — shogeg karov lemezid, deibbei leh lemitameh.
Uremi mezid ammezid — hacha katane: bemezid lo asa kelum, hatam tenan: hattorem mishsheen nakuv al nakuv — teruma, veyachzor veyitrom!
Bitre mane — tzayet, bechad mana — la tzayet.
Ulerav natan berabbi oshaya, deamar: lo asa velo chelum — letakken shirayim, aval teruma have,
b: May shena meha ditnan: min hannakuv al sheen nakuv — terumato teruma, velo teachel ad sheyyotzi aleha teruma umaaser mimmakom acher.

Shane hacha, demiddeorayyta teruma meallayyta hi, kidrabbi ilay. deamar rabbi ilay: minnayin lattorem min haraa al hayyafa shetterumato teruma — dichtiv: "velo tisu alav chet baharimchem et chelbo mimmennu".
Veim en kadosh — nesiut chet lamma? mikkan lattorem min haraa al hayyafa — shetterumato teruma.

Amar leh rabba lerav chisda: ledidach deamrat lo asa velo kelum kol ikkar, daafillu hahu geriva hadar letivleh, may tama — gezera dilma pasha vela mafresh, mi ikka midde demiddeorayyta have teruma, umishshum dilma pasha appeku rabbanan lechullin? vechi bet din matnin laakor davar min hattora?
Amar leh: veat la tisbera? vehatnan: havvalad mamzer mizze umizze. bishlama mishsheni mamzer — ella merishon ammay? ishto hi, veyisrael mealleya hu, veka sharenan leh bemamzeret!
Amar leh, hachi amar shemuel: asur bemamzeret. vechen ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan: asur bemamzeret. veammay kare leh "mamzer" — leosro bevat yisrael.

Shelach leh rav chisda lerabba beyad rav acha bar rav huna: veen bet din matnin laakor davar min hattora? vehatanya: meematay adam yoresh et ishto ketanna? bet shammay omrim: mishshettaamod bekomatah, uvet hillel omrim: mishshettikkanes lachuppa, rabbi eliezer omer: mishshettibbael. veyorshah, umittamme lah, veochelet begino teruma.

Bet shammay omrim: mishshettaamod bekomatah. af al gav delo nichnesa lachuppa? ema: mishshettaamod bekomatah vetikkanes lachuppa. vehachi kaamru leh bet shammay levet hillel: dekaamritu mishshettikkanes lachuppa, i amda bekomatah — mahneya la chuppa, vei la — la mahneya la chuppa.
Rabbi eliezer omer: mishshettibbael. vehaamar rabbi eliezer: en maase ketanna kelum! ema: mishshettagdil vetibbael.
Katane mihat yorshah — veha hacha, demiddeorayyta avuha yaret la, umidderabbanan yaret la baal?! hefker bet din hefker.
Deamar rabbi yitzchak: minnayin shehefker bet din hefker — shenneemar: "kol asher lo yavo lishloshet hayyamim baatzat hassarim vehazzekenim yochoram kol rechusho vehu yibbadel mikkehal haggola".

Rabbi elazar amar, mehacha: "elle hannechalot asher nichalu elazar hakkohen vihoshua bin nun verashe haavot lemattot bene yisrael", vechi ma inyan rashim etzel avot? ella lomar lach: ma avot manchilin benehem kol ma sheyyirtzu — af rashim manchilin et haam kol ma sheyyirtzu.
Umittamme lah. veha hacha, demiddeorayyta aviha mittamme lah, umidderabbanan mittamme lah baal! mishshum dehavya la met mitzva.
Umi havya[1] met mitzva? vehatanya: e zehu met mitzva — kol sheen lo kovrin. kore vaacherim onin oto — en ze met mitzva! hacha name, kevan dela yarti la — karya vela anu la.

a: Veochelet begino teruma. bitruma derabbanan. ta shema: achal teruma temea — meshallem chullin tehorim. shillem chullin temeim, somchos omer mishshum rabbi meir: beshogeg — tashlumav tashlumin, bemezid — en tashlumav tashlumin. vachachamim omrim: echad ze veechad ze — tashlumav tashlumin, vechozer umeshallem chullin tehorin.
Vehavenan ba: bemezid en tashlumav tashlumin? tavo alav beracha, daachal minneh midde dela (ka)chaze leh bime tumeato, veka meshallem midde d(ka)chaze leh bime tumeato.

Veamar rava, veamri la kedi: chassore michassera vehachi katane: achal teruma temea — meshallem kol dehu. achal teruma tehora — meshallem chullin tehorin, shillem chullin temeim — somchos omer mishshum rabbi meir: beshogeg — tashlumav tashlumin, bemezid — en tashlumav tashlumin. vachachamim omrim: ben beshogeg ben bemezid — tashlumav tashlumin, vechozer umeshallem chullin tehorin.
Veha hacha, demiddeorayyta tashlume mealleya have, dei mekaddesh behu kohen ishsha — tafsu la kiddushe, vaamur rabbanan en tashlumav tashlumin, vekasharenan eshet ish lealma!
May en tashlumav tashlumin dekaamar rabbi meir — devae lemehdar shallome chullin tehorin. i hachi, somchos hayeynu rabbanan!
Amar rav acha bereh derav ika: kansu shogeg attu mezid ikka benayyhu.
Ta shema: dam shennitma uzerako, beshogeg — huretza, bemezid — lo huretza.

Veha hacha, demiddeorayyta artzoye meratztze, detanya: al ma hatztzitz meratztze — al haddam, veal habbasar, veal hachelev shennitma, ben beshogeg ben bemezid, ben beones ben beratzon, ben beyachid ben betzibbur. veamri rabbanan: lo huretza, veka hadar meayyel chullin laazara!
Amar rabbi yose bar chanina: may "lo huretza" dekaamar — lehattir basar baachila, aval bealim nitkapperu bo.
Sof sof kamitakkera achilat basar, uchetiv: "veachlu otam asher kuppar bahem", melammed shehakkohanim ochlim uvealim mitkapperim! amar leh: shev veal taase shane.
b: Amar leh, beay leotovach: arel, hazzaa.
Veizmel, sadin betzitzit.
Vechivse atzeret, veshofar,
Velulav. hasheta deshannit lan "shev veal taase" la miakar hu, kullehu name "shev veal taase" ninhu.
Ta shema: "elav tishmaun" — afillu omer lecha: avor al achat mikkol mitzvot shebbattora, kegon eliyyahu behar hakkarmel, hakkol lefi shaa — shema lo.
Shane hatam, dichtiv: "elav tishmaun". veligmar minneh! migdar milleta shane.
Ta shema: bittelo — mevuttal, divre rabbi. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: eno yachol lo levattelo, velo lehosif al tenao. im ken — ma koach bet din yafe.
Veha hacha, demiddeorayyta batel get, umishshum "ma koach bet din" ka sharenan eshet ish lealma! man dimkaddesh — addata derabbanan mekaddesh, veafkeinhu rabbanan lekiddushin,
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: hatinach dekaddesh bechaspa, kaddesh bevia may ikka lememar? shavveyu rabbanan livilato beilat zenut.

Ta shema, amar rabbi elazar ben yaakov: shamati shebbet din makkin veonshin shello min hattora, velo laavor al divre tora, ella laasot seyayg lattora. umaase beadam echad sherachav al sus bashshabbat bime yevanim — veheviuhu levet din usekaluhu, lo mippene sherauy lechach, ella shehashshaa tzericha lechach.
Veshuv maase beadam echad shehetiach beishto tachat hatteena, veheviuhu levet din vehilkuhu. lo mippene sherauy lechach, ella shehashshaa tzericha lechach! migdar milleta shane.
Velo ze vaze metammein lah. menalan? dichtiv: "ki im lishero hakkarov elav", veamar mar: "sheero" — zo ishto,
Uchetiv: "lo yittamma baal beammav lehechallo", yesh baal shemmittamme, veyesh baal sheen mittamme. ha ketzad? mittamme hu leishto keshera, veeno mittamme leishto pesula.
Velo ze vaze zakkain bimtziatah vechulei. tama may amur rabbanan metziat ishsha levalah — ki hechi dela tihve leh eva. hacha tihve leh eva veeva.
Uvemaase yadeha. tama may amri rabbanan maase yadeha levalah — mishshum dekaachla mezone, hacha kevan dimzone let la — maase yadeha lav dideh.
Velo mefer nedareha. tama may amar rachamana baal mefer — kede shello titganne, hacha titganne vetitganne.
Hayta bat yisrael nifsela min hakkehunna vechulei.

a: Peshita! bat levi min hammaaser itztericha leh.
Uvat levi min hammaaser mi mippasla biznut? vehatanya: leviyya shennishbet, o shennivala beilat zenut — notnin lah maaser veochelet. amar rav sheshet: kenasa.
Bat kohen min hatteruma. afillu bitruma derabbanan.
Veen yorshav shel ze veyorshav shel ze yorshin ketubbatah vechulei. ketubba may avidta! amar rav pappa: ketubbat benin dichrin.
Peshita! mahu detema: ledida daavada issura — kansuha rabbanan, lezara la kenasu rabbanan — ka mashma lan.

Achiv shel ze veachiv shel ze choltzin velo meyaybmin. achiv shel rishon choletz — middeorayyta, vela meyaybem — midderabbanan. achiv shel sheni choletz — midderabbanan, vela meyaybem — la middeorayyta vela midderabbanan.
Rabbi yose omer: ketubbatah al nichse balah vechulei. amar rav huna: batrae modu lekammae, kammae la modu levatrae.

Rabbi shimon mode leh lerabbi elazar: dema bia deikkar issura — la kanes, vechol shekken metziatah umaase yadeha — demamona hu. verabbi elazar la mode leh lerabbi shimon: metziatah umaase yadeha demamona hu — la kanes, aval bia deissura hu — kanes.

Vetarvayyhu modu leh lerabbi yose: hane deyatva tuteh la kanes, vechol shekken ketubba dilmishkal umippak kae. verabbi yose la mode lehu, ketubba dilmishkal umippak — hu dela kanes, aval hane deyatva tuteh — kanes.

Rabbi yochanan amar: kammae modu levatrae, batrae la modu lekammae. rabbi yose mode leh lerabbi elazar: ketubba, demiddideh ledida — la kanes, vechol shekken metziatah umaase yadeha, demiddida ledideh.
Verabbi elazar la mode leh: metziatah umaase yadeha hu demiddida ledideh — la kanes, aval ketuva demiddideh ledida — kanes.
Vetarvayyhu modu leh lerabbi shimon: uma hane, demechayyim — la kansi, bia dilachar mita — lo kol shekken. verabbi shimon la mode lehu: bia hu dilachar mita la kanes, aval hane demechayyim — kanes.

Nisset shello birshut vechulei. amar rav huna amar rav: hachi hilcheta. amar leh rav nachman: gannava gannove lema lach? i sevira lach kerabbi shimon, ema: halacha kerabbi shimon, dishmataych kerabbi shimon kaazla.
Vechi tema: i amena halacha kerabbi shimon — mashma afillu bekammayyta, ema: halacha kerabbi shimon baacharona! kashya.
Amar rav sheshet: amena, ki nayem veshachev rav amra leha shemateta. halacha mikkelal difligi, may hava la lemibad — menas anisa?
Veod tanya: kol arayot shebbattora en tzerichot hemennu get, chutz meeshet ish shennisset al pi bet din. al pi bet din hu devaaya gitta, al pi edim la baaya gitta.
Manni? ilema rabbi shimon, al pi bet din mi baaya get? vehatanya, rabbi shimon omer: asu bet din behoraatan — kizdon ish beishsha. al pi edim — keshiggat ish beishsha. idde veidi la baaya get.
Ella lav rabbanan hi.
Leolam rabbi shimon hi, vetaretz hachi: rabbi shimon omer: asu bet din behoraatan — kechauonat ish beishsha [uvaaya get], al pi edim — keshello bechauonat ish beishsha [velo baaya get].
Rav ashe amar, leinyan issura katane, vehachi kaamar: asu bet din behoraatan — kizdon ish beishsha, umittasra al bala. al pi edim — keshiggat ish beishsha, vela mittasra al bala.
b: Ravina amar, leinyan korban katane: asu bet din behoraatan — kizdon ish baishsha, vela matya korban. al pi edim — keshiggat ish beishsha, umatya korban.
Veibbaet ema: ha kammayyta — rabbanan hi, vetaretz hachi: chutz meeshet ish, veshennisset al pi bet din.

Metiv ulla: mi amrinan may hava la lemibad? vehatnan: katav leshem malchut sheenah hogenet, leshem malchut maday, leshem malchut yavan, levinyan habbayit, lechureban habbayit, haya bammizrach vechatav bammaarav, bammaarav vechatav bammizrach —
Tetze mizze umizze, vechol hadderachim haellu bah. veammay? lema: may hava la lemibad! ibbei la leakroye legitta.

Amar rav shimi bar ashe, ta shema: hakkones et yevimto vehalcha tzaratah venisset, venimtzet zo aylonit — tetze mizze umizze, vechol hadderachim haellu bah. veammay? nema: may hava la lemibad? ibbei la leamtone.

Amar abbaye, ta shema: kol arayot sheamru potrot tzarotehen, halchu tzarot venisseu venimtzeu ellu ayloniyyot — tetze mizze umizze, vechol hadderachim haellu bah. veammay? nema: may hava la lemibad? ibbei la leamtone.
Amar rava, ta shema: katav sofer get laish veshovar laishsha, vetaa venatan get laishsha veshovar laish, venatnu ze laze veze laze,

Uleachar zeman hare hagget yotze mittachat yede haish, veshovar mittachat yede haishsha — tetze mizze umizze, vechol hadderachim haellu bah. veammay? nema: may hava la lemebad! ibbei la leakroye legitta.
Amar rav ashe, ta shema: shinna shemo ushemah, shem iro veshem irah — tetze mizze umizze, vechol hadderachim haellu bah. veammay? nema: may hava la lemibad! ibbei la leakroye legitta.
Amar ravina, ta shema: kenasah beget kereach tetze mizze umizze kulei — ibbei la leakroye legitta.
Rav pappa savar lemibad ovada bemay hava la lemibad. amar leh rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerav pappa: vehatanya kol hane matneyayta!
Amar leh: velav shanninhu! amar leh: veashshinnuye leku velismoch! (ufesak).
Amar rav ashe, ulekala la chayyshinan. he kala? illema kala devatar nissuin — ha amra rav ashe chada zimna, deamar rav ashe:

a: Kol kala devatar nissuin la chayyshinan! mahu detema: hoil vaatay leve dina usherenan, kekala dekamme nissuin dame vetittesar, ka mashma lan.
Nisset al pi bet din tetze vechulei. amar zeeri: leta lematnitin, midditnan be midresha. detane be midresha: horu bet din sheshshaka chamma, ulevassof zarcha — en zo horaa, ella taut.
Verav nachman amar: horaa hi.

Amar rav nachman: teda dehoraa hi, divchol hattora kullah ed echad la meheman vehacha meheman, may tama? lav mishshum dehoraa hi. amar rava: teda detaut hu, deillu horu bet din bechelev uvedam lehettera, vahadar chazo tama leissura, ki hadri veamri lehettera — la mashgechinan behu.
Veillu, hecha daata ed echad — sherena. ato tere — asarna. ki hadar ata ed acharina — sharenan la. may tama, lav mishshum detaut hu?!

Veaf rabbi eliezer savar detaut hu, detanya, rabbi eliezer omer: yikkov haddin et hahar, vetavi chattat shemena. i amrat bishlama detaut hu — mishshum hachi matya korban, ella i amrat dehoraa hi, ammay matya korban?
Vedilma kasavar rabbi eliezer yachid sheasa behoraat bet din chayyayv?! im ken, ma "yikkov haddin et hahar".
Horuha bet din lehinnase kulei. may "kilkela"? rabbi elyazar omer: zinneta. rabbi yochanan amar: almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot.
Man deamar zinneta — kol shekken almana lechohen gadol. man deamar almana lechohen gadol, aval zinneta — la. may tama — [deamra] attun hu deshavvitun penuya.
Tanya kevoteh derabbi yochanan: horuha bet din lehinnase vehalcha vekilkela, kegon: almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot — chayyevet bekorban al kol bia uvia, divre rabbi elazar,
Vachachamim omrim: korban echad al hakkol. umodim chachamim lerabbi elazar sheim nisset lachamishsha bene adam — shechayyevet bekorban al kol echad veechad, hoil vegufin muchelakin.

Mishna haishsha shehalach balah uvenah limdinat hayyam, uvau veamru lah: met balich veachar kach met benech, venisset, veachar kach amru lah: chilluf hayu haddevarim — tetze, vehavvalad rishon veacharon mamzer.

Amru lah: met benech veachar kach met balich, venityaybma, veachar kach amru lah: chilluf hayu haddevarim — tetze, vehavvalad rishon veacharon mamzer. amru lah: met balich venisset, veachar kach amru lah: kayyaym haya vamet — tetze, vehavvalad rishon — mamzer, vehaacharon — eno mamzer.

Amru lah: met balich, venitkaddesha, veachar kach ba balah — mutteret lachzor lo. af al pi shennatan lah acharon get — lo pesalah min hakkehunna. et zo darash rabbi elazar ben matya: "veishsha gerusha meishah" — velo meish sheeno ishah.
Gemara may rishon umay acharon? illema rishon — lifne shemua, veacharon — leachar shemua, litne: havvalad mamzer!
Mishshum dekavae lemitne sefa: amru lah met balich venisset, veachar kach amru lah kayyaym haya umet, harishon mamzer vehaacharon eno mamzer — tena name resha rishon veacharon mamzer.
Tanu rabbanan: zo divre rabbi akiva, shehaya omer: en kiddushin tofsin bechayyayve lavin. aval chachamim omrim: en mamzer miyyevama. velema: en mamzer mechayyayve lavin!
Hay tanna — hach tanna derabbi akiva hu, deamar: mechayyayve lavin disher have mamzer, mechayyayve lavin geridi — la have mamzer. amar rav yehuda
b: Amar rav: minnayin sheen kiddushin tofsin bivama, shenneemar: "lo tihye eshet hammet hachutza leish zar" — lo tehe bah havaya lezar.
Ushemuel amar: baaniyyutenu, tzericha get. mesappeka leh lishmuel hay "la tihye eshet hammet", i lelav hu daata, i dela tafsi ba kiddushin hu daata.

Amar leh rav mari bar rachel lerav ashe, hachi amar ammemar: halacha kevoteh dishmuel. amar rav ashe: hasheta deamar ammemar hilcheta kevoteh dishmuel — im haya yevamah kohen, choletz lah, vesharya leh.
Ittegore ittegar, im ken matzinu chote niskar! ella, im haya yevamah yisrael, noten lah sheni get, vehuttera lo.
Amar rav giddel amar rav chiyyay bar yosef amar rav: yevama — kiddushin en bah, nissuin yesh bah. i kiddushin en bah — nissuin name en bah! ema: kiddushin venissuin en bah.
Veibbaet ema: may "nissuin yesh bah" — biznut, kidrav hamenuna. deamar rav hamenuna: shomeret yavam shezzinneta — asura livamah.
Vei baet ema, leolam kedaamaran meikkara: kiddushin en bah, nissuin yesh bah. demichallefa beishsha shehalach balah limdinat hayyam.

Amar rabbi yannay: bachavura, nimnu vegamru: en kiddushin tofsin bivama. amar leh rabbi yochanan: rabbi, lo mishnatenu hi zo? ditnan, haomer laishsha: "hare at mekuddeshet li leachar sheetgayyer", "leachar shettitgayyeyri", "leachar sheeshtachrer", "leachar shettishtachreri", "leachar sheyyamut balich", "leachar shettamut achotich", o "leachar sheyyachlotz lich yevamich" — enah mekuddeshet. amar leh: i lav dedallay lach chaspa, mi mashkachat marganita tuteh?
Amar leh resh lakish: i lav dekallesach gavra rabba, hava amena lach ana: matnitin rabbi akiva hi, deamar: en kiddushin tofsin bechayyayve lavin.
Vei rabbi akiva, ki amar la "leachar sheyyachalotz lich yevamich" litpesu bah kiddushe! deha shaminan leh lerabbi akiva deamar: adam makne davar shello ba laolam. ditnan:

a: Kuvnnam sheani osa leficha — en tzarich lehafer.
Rabbi akiva omer: yafer, shemma taadif alav yoter min harauy lo.
Ha ittemar ala: amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: beomeret: "yikdeshu yaday leosehem", deyadayim itanhu bealma.

Ufeliga derav nachman bar yitzchak. deamar rav nachman bar yitzchak: rav huna kerav, verav kerabbi yannay, verabbi yannay kerabbi chiyyay, verabbi chiyyay kerabbi, verabbi kerabbi meir, verabbi meir kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov, verabbi eliezer ben yaakov kerabbi akiva, deamar: adam makne davar shello ba laolam.
Rav huna may hi? deittemar: hammocher perot dekel lachavero, amar rav huna: ad shello bau laolam — yachol lachzor bo. mishshebbau laolam — en yachol lachzor bo.
Verav nachman amar: af mishshebbau laolam — yachol lachzor bo. amar rav nachman: modena dei shamet veachel — la mappekinan minneh.
Rav — deamar rav huna amar rav: haomer lachavero "sade zo sheani lokeach lichsheekkachenna, kenuya lecha meachshav" — kana.

Rabbi yannay kerabbi chiyyay — derabbi yannay hava leh arisa dahava mayyte leh kanta defere kol maale shabbeta. hahu yoma nega leh vela ata. shekal assar mippere deveteh alayyhu. ata lekammeh derabbi chiyyay,

Amar leh: shappir avadt. detanya: "lemaan tilmad leyira et Adonai elohecha kol hayyamim" — ellu shabbatot veyamim tovim. lemay hilcheta? illema leassore umechal, itzterich kera lemishre tiltul derabbanan?!
b: Ella lav, ki hay gavvna. amar leh: veha akreyun bechelma "kane ratzutz", may lav, hachi kaamri li: "hinne vatachta lecha al mishenet hakkane haratzutz hazze"?
La, hachi kaamri lach: "kane ratzutz lo yishbor ufishta cheha lo yechabbenna".

Rabbi — detanya: "lo tasgir eved el adonav", rabbi omer: belokeach eved al menat leshachrero hakkatuv medabber. hechi dame? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: dichtav leh lichsheekkachacha — hare atzmecha kanuy lecha meachshav.

Rabbi meir — ditnan, haomer leishsha: "hare at mekuddeshet li leachar sheetgayyer", "leachar shettitgayyeyri", "leachar sheeshtachrer", "leachar shettishtachreri", "leachar sheyyamut balich", "leachar shettamut achotich", "leachar sheyyachlotz lich yevamich" — enah mekuddeshet. rabbi meir omer: mekuddeshet.

Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov — detanya: yater al ken amar rabbi eliezer ben yaakov: afillu im amar "perot aruga zo telushim yehu teruma al perot aruga mechubbarim", o "perot aruga mechubbarim al perot zo telushin, lichsheyyaviu shelish veyittalshu", veheviu shelish venitleshu — devarav kayyaymin.
Rabbi akiva — ditnan: "kuvnnam sheani osa leficha" — eno tzarich lehafer. rabbi akiva omer: yafer, shemma taadif alav yeter min harauy lo.

Beo minneh merav sheshet: ed echad bivama, mahu? tama deed echad — mishshum demilleta daavida leiggalloye la meshakkar, vehacha name la meshakkar. o dilma: tama deed echad mishshum — deihi dayyka uminnasva. vehacha, kevan dezimnin derachama leh — la dayyka uminnasva.

Amar lehu rav sheshet: tenetuha, amru lah: met benech veachar kach met balich venityaybma, veachar kach amru lah chilluf haddevarim — tetze, vehavvalad rishon veacharon mamzer. hechi dame: illema tere utere — may chazet desamchat ahane, semoch ahane!
Veod, mamzer? sefek mamzer hu. vechi tema la dak, veha middekatane sefa: harishon mamzer vehaacharon eno mamzer, shema minna davka katane.
Ella lav shema minna: chad. vetama daato be tere achchashu, ha lav hachi — meheman.
Veikka deamar: ha la tibbee lach daafillu ihi name mehemna, ditnan: haishsha sheamra met bali — tinnase. met bali — tityaybem. ki tibbee lach lemishre yevama lealma:
May tama deed echad — mishshum demilleta daavida leiggalloye la meshakkar, hacha name la meshakkar. o dilma: tama deed echad, mishshum deihi dayyka uminnasva, veha la dayyka uminnasva — demisna hu

a: Desanya leh. amar lehu rav sheshet: tenetuha. amru lah: "met balich veachar kach met benech" venisset, veachar kach amru lah: "chilluf hayu haddevarim" — tetze, vehavvalad rishon veacharon mamzer.

Hechi dame: illema tere utere — may chazet desamchat ahane, semoch ahane? veod, mamzer? sefek mamzer hu. vechi tema la dak — ha middekatane sefa: harishon mamzer vehaacharon eno mamzer, shema minna dedavka katane!
Ella lav: chad, vetama daato be tere achchashu, ha lav hachi — meheman! laolam tere utere, vechidamar rav acha bar minyome, beede hazama,
Hacha name beede hazama.

Amar leh rav mardochay lerav ashe, veamri leh rav acha lerav ashe, ta shema: en haishsha neemenet lomar met yevami, sheennase, velo meta achoti, sheekkanes levetah. hi nihi dela mehemna, ha ed echad — meheman!

Velitamaych, ema sefa: en haish neeman lomar met achi, sheayaybem et ishto, velo meta ishti, sheessa et achotah. hu nihu dela meheman, ha ed echad — meheman, bishlama gabbe ishsha, mishshum igguna akkilu ba rabbanan, ella gabbe ish may ikka lememar?

Ella, ki itzterich — lerabbi akiva itzterich, salka datach amena: hoil veamar rabbi akiva yesh mamzer mechayyayve lavin, ema chayysha akkilkula dezara vedayyka, ka mashma lan (deakkilkula dida chayysha, akkilkula dezara la chayysha).

Rava amar: ed echad neeman bivama mikkal vachomer. leissur karet hittarta, leissur lav lo kol shekken?! amar leh hahu merabbanan lerava: hi atzmah tochiach, dilissur karet hittarta — leissur lav lo hittarta!
Veella ihi may tama la mehemna, dechevan dezimnin desanya leh, la dayyka uminnasva, ed echad name: dechevan dezimnin desanya leh, la dayyka uminnasva.
Ze midrash darash rabbi elazar ben matya vechulei. amar rav yehuda amar rav: hava leh lerabbi elazar lemidrash beh marganita uderash beh chaspa.
May marganita — detanya: "veishsha gerusha meishah", afillu lo nitgarsha ella meishah — pesula lakkehunna, vehayeynu reach hagget defosel bichhunna.
Mishna mi shehalcha ishto limdinat hayyam, bau veamru lo "meta ishtecha", venasa et achotah, veachar kach bat ishto — mutteret lachzor
b: Lo. umuttar bikrovot sheniyya, usheniyya mutteret bikrovav. veim meta rishona — muttar bashsheniyya.

Amru lo: meta ishto, venasa et achotah. veachar kach amru lo: kayyemet hayta, umeta. havvalad rishon — mamzer, vehaacharon — en mamzer. rabbi yose omer: kol shepposel al yede acherim — posel al yede atzmo, vechol sheen posel al yede acherim — eno posel al yede atzmo.
Gemara veaf al gav daazul ishto vegiso limdinat hayyam, deahani hane nissuim dekamittasra eshet giso aggiso, afillu hachi: eshet giso asira, ishto sharya,
Vela amrinan: mittoch shenneesra eshet giso aggiso, teaser ishto alav. lema matnitin dela kerabbi akiva, dei rabbi akiva — havya la achot gerushato.

Detanya: kol arayot shebbattora — en tzerichot hemennu get, chutz meeshet ish shennisset al pi bet din, verabbi akiva mosif af eshet ach vaachot ishsha. vechevan deamar rabbi akiva baaya get, mimmela ittasra aleh, dehavya la achot gerushato.

Velav ittemar ala, amar rav giddel amar rav chiyyay bar yosef amar rav: hay eshet ach hechi dame — kegon shekkiddesh achiv et haishsha, vehalach limdinat hayyam, veshama shemmet achiv, veamad venasa et ishto, deamri inashe: hach kamma, tenaa hava leh bekiddushin, vehay shappir nasev.

Vehay achot ishsha name hechi dame — kegon shekkiddesh et ishsha, vehalcha limdinat hayyam, veshama shemmeta, amad venasa et achotah. deamri inashe: hach kammayyta, tenae hava leh bekiddusheha, veha shappir nasev. ella nissuin, mi ikka lememar tenaa hava leh benissuin?
Amar leh rav ashe lerav kahana: i rabbi akiva, litne name chamoto. deha shaminan leh lerabbi akiva, deamar: chamoto leachar mita — lav bisrefa.
Detanya: "baesh yisrefu oto veethen" — oto veet achat mehen, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer: oto veet shetehen.
Bishlama leabbaye deamar mashmaut dorshin ikka benayyhu, derabbi yishmael savar: chada ketiv, verabbi akiva savar: tarte ketiv — shappir.
Ella lerava, deamar: chamoto leachar mita ikka benayyhu — litne name chamoto!
Amar leh: nehi demayata kera misserefa — meissura mi mayata kera?
Veteaser bishchiva daachotah, midde dehave aishsha shehalach balah limdinat hayyam! la dame: ishto, divmezid asira middeorayyta, beshogeg gezaru ba rabbanan,

a: Achot ishsha, divmezid la asira middeorayyta, beshogeg la gezaru ba rabbanan. umenalan dela asira, detanya: "otah", otah — shechivatah osartah, veen shechivat achotah osartah.
Sheyyachol, vahalo din hu: uma bimkom shebba al issur kal — neesar haoser, mekom shebba al issur chamur — eno din shenneesar haoser.

Amar rabbi yehuda: lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel beva al chamoto sheppasal et ishto, al ma nechleku — beva al achot ishto, shebbet shammay omrim: pasal, uvet hillel omrim: lo pasal. amar rabbi yose: lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel beva al achot ishto shello pasal et ishto, al ma nechleku — beva al chamoto, shebbet shammay omrim: pasal, uvet hillel omrim: lo pasal.

Lefi shebbattechilla, hu muttar bechol hannashim shebbaolam, vehi mutteret bechol haanashim shebbaolam. kiddeshah — hu asarah, vehi asarattu. merubbe issur sheasarah, meissur sheasarathu. shehu asarah bechol anashim shebbaolam, vehi la asarathu ella bikrovoteha.

Vahalo din hu: uma hu, sheasarah bechol anashim shebbaolam, shagga baasur lah — enah neeseret bammuttar lah, hi, shello asarathu ella bikrovoteha, shagag baasur lo — eno din shello neesar (lo) bammuttar lo?!
Veze haddin leshogeg. lemezid minnayin? talmud lomar: "otah", otah — shechivatah osartah, veen shechivat achotah osartah.
Amar rabbi amme amar resh lakish: may tama derabbi yehuda — dichtiv: "baesh yisrefu oto veethen", vechi kol habbayit kullo bisrefa?! im eno inyan lisrefa, tenehu inyan leissura.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: en halacha kerabbi yehuda. hahu daavad issura bachamateh. atyeh rav yehuda, naggedeh. amar leh: i lav deamar shemuel en halacha kerabbi yehuda — asrita alach issura dealam.
May "issur kal"? amar rav chisda: machzir gerushato mishshennisset.
Ba aleha hay — asra aleh dehay. ba aleha iddach — asra aleh dehay.
Ma lemachzir gerushato mishshennisset, shekken nitma hagguf, veissurah berov, veissurah issur olam.
Ella amar resh lakish: yevama. yevama leman? illema leacher, vechidrav hamenuna, deamar rav hamenuna: shomeret yavam shezzinneta asura livamah —
Ma livama shekken nitma hagguf, veissurah berov.
Ella yevama laachin. avad ba maamar hay — asra aleh dehay. ba aleha iddach — asra aleh dehay. may irya shebba aleha sheni? afillu avad bah name maamar!
Ha la kashya, kerabban gamliel, deamar: en maamar achar maamar. ella, afillu natan lah get, vaafillu chalatz lah!
Ella amar rabbi yochanan: sota. sota leman? ilema labbaal: ba aleha baal — asra aleh devoel. may irya ba aleha? afillu natan lah get — vaafillu amar "en ani mashke"!
Ella sota labboel. hay issur kal hu? issur chamur hu, dehayynu eshet ish!
b: Ella amar rava: eshet ish. vechen ki ata ravin, amar rabbi yochanan: eshet ish. umay kare la "issur kal" — sheen haosrah osrah kol yamav. tanya name hachi: abba chanan amar mishshum rabbi elazar: eshet ish.
Uma bimkom habba al issur kal, sheen haosrah osrah kol yamav — neesar haoser, habba al issur chamur, shehaosrah osrah kol yamav — eno din shenneesar haosrah?
Talmud lomar: "otah", otah — shechivatah osartah, veen shechivat achotah osartah.
Rabbi yose omer: kol shepposel vechulei. may kaamar rabbi yose? illema dekaamar tanna kamma, deazel ishto vegiso limdinat hayyam — eshet giso asira, veishto sharya,

Vekaamar leh rabbi yose: ki hechi deishto sharya — eshet giso name sharya. i hachi, kol sheen posel al yede acherim — en posel al yede atzmo, kol sheen posel al yede atzmo — eno posel al yede acherim, mibbaya leh!
Veella ki hechi deeshet giso asira — ishto name asira. hatinach "kol shepposel", — "kol sheeno posel" may avidteh?
Amar rabbi amme aresha: nisset al pi bet din — tetze, ufetura min hakkorban. al pi edim — tetze, vechayyevet bekorban. yippa kocho shel bet din, sheppotrah min hakkorban.
Vekaamar tanna kamma: la shena al pi edim, deeshet giso sharya. vela shena al pi bet din, deeshet giso asira.
Vekaamar leh rabbi yose: al pi bet din, defosel al yede acherim — posel al yede atzmo. al pi edim, deeno posel al yede acherim — eno posel al yede atzmo.

Rabbi yitzchak nappacha amar: leolam assefa (ha — dinsev eshet giso, veha — dinsev arusat giso). ha — deazli arusato vegiso, ha — deazli ishto vegiso, vekaamar tanna kamma: la shena ishto vegiso, vela shena arusato vegiso — eshet giso asira, veishto sharya,

Vekaamar leh rabbi yose: ishto vegiso, delekka lememar tenaa hava leh benissuin, deeno posel al yede acher — eno posel al yede atzmo. arusato vegiso, deikka lememar tenaa hava leh bekiddushin, ufosel al yede acherim — af posel al yede atzmo.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yose. matkef la rav yosef: umi amar shemuel hachi? vehaittemar: yevama, rav amar: hare hi keeshet ish, ushemuel amar: enah keeshet ish. veamar rav huna: kegon shekkiddesh achiv et haishsha, vehalach lo limdinat hayyam, veshama shemmet achiv, veamad venasa et ishto.
Derav amar: hare hi keeshet ish — vaasura layyavam, ushemuel amar: enah keeshet ish, vesharya leh!
Amar leh abbaye: umimmay dechi amar shemuel halacha kerabbi yose — adderabbi yitzchak nappacha kaamar? dilma adderabbi amme kaamar! vei name adderabbi yitzchak nappacha, mimmay deapposel",

a: Vedilma aeno posel"?! i name: mimmay deita lidrav huna? dilma leta derav huna kelal, uvidrav hamenuna kamippalgi. deamar rav hamenuna: shomeret yavam shezzinneta — asura livamah.

Derav amar: hare hi keeshet ish, umippasla biznut. ushemuel amar: enah keeshet ish, vela mippasla biznut. vei name, bekiddushin tofsin bivama kamippalgi, derav amar: hare hi keeshet ish, vela tafsi ba kiddushin. ushemuel amar: enah keeshet ish, vetafsi ba kiddushin.
Veha ippeligu ba chada zimna? chada mikkelal dachaverta ittemar.

Mishna amru lo: "meta ishtecha", venasa achotah meaviha. meta, venasa achotah meimmah. meta, venasa achotah meaviha. meta, venasa achotah meimmah, venimtzeu kullan kayyaymot — muttar barishona uvashshelishit uvachamishit, ufotrot tzarotehen.
Veasur bashsheniyya uvarviit, veen biat achat mehen poteret tzaratah.
Veim ba al hashsheniyya leachar mitat harishona — muttar bashsheniyya uvarviit, ufotrot tzarotehen, veasur bashshelishit uvachamishit, veen biat achat mehen poteret tzaratah.
Ben tesha shanim veyom echad — hu posel al yede achin, vehaachin poslin al yado. ella hu posel techilla, vehaachin poslin techilla vasof.
Ketzad? ben tesha shanim veyom echad shebba al yevimto — pasal al yede achin. bau aleha achin veasu bah maamar, natnu get o chaltzu — poslin al yado.
Gemara attu kullehu lav leachar mitat rishona ninhu? amar rav sheshet: leachar mitat rishona vadday.

Ben tesha shanim vechulei. ben tesha shanim veyom echad, techilla pasel besof la pasel? vehatane rav zevid bar rav oshaya: haose maamar bivimto, veachar kach ba achiv shehu ben tesha shanim veyom echad aleha — pesalah!

Amri: bia — pasel afillu besof, maamar — techilla pasel, besof la pasel. uvia afillu besof pasel? veha katane: ella shehu posel techilla, vehen techilla vasof. ketzad? ben tesha shanim veyom echad shebba al yevimto vechulei!

Chassore michassera vehachi katane: ben tesha shanim veyom echad — hu posel techilla, vehen poslin techilla vasof. bamme devarim amurim — bemaamar, aval bia poselet afillu bassof. ketzad: ben tesha shanim veyom echad habba al yevimto — pasal al yede achin.

Umi it leh maamar kelal al yede achin? vehatanya: ben tesha shanim veyom echad, hu posel bedavar echad, vehaachin poslin al yado bearbaa devarim. hu posel al yede achin bevia, vehaachin poslin al yado bevia, bemaamar, beget, bachalitza!
Bia defasla ben bitchilla ben besof — pesika leh, maamar devitchilla pasel, besof la pasel — la pesika leh.
Ittemar name, amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: yesh lo get. vechen amar rav tachlifa bar avimi: yesh lo maamar. tanya name hachi: yesh lo get, veyesh lo maamar, divre rabbi meir.

Vesavar rabbi meir yesh lo get? vehatanya: asu biat ben tesha kemaamar baggadol, rabbi meir omer: asu chalitzat ben tesha keget baggadol. veim ita — litne: kegitto! amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: it leh vezutar.
Lerabban gamliel, deamar en get achar get — hane mille begadol achar gadol vekatan achar katan, aval gadol achar katan — mahane.
Lerabbanan, deamri yesh get achar get — hane mille begadol achar gadol, o bekatan achar katan, aval katan achar gadol — la mahane.
b: Mishna ben tesha shanim veyom echad shebba al yevimto, veachar kach ba aleha achiv shehu ben tesha shanim veyom echad — posal al yado. rabbi shimon omer: lo pasal. ben tesha shanim veyom echad shebba al yevimto, veachar kach ba al tzaratah — pasal al yede atzmo. rabbi shimon omer: lo pasal.
Gemara tanya, amar lahem rabbi shimon lachachamim: im bia rishona bia — bia sheniyyay enah bia. veim bia rishona enah bia — bia sheniyyay name enah bia.
Matnitin dela keven azzay. detanya, ben azzay omer: yesh maamar achar maamar bishne yevamin vivama achat.
Veen maamar achar maamar bishte yevamot veyavam echad.

Mishna ben tesha shanim veyom echad shebba al yevimto umet — choletzet velo mityaybemet. nasa ishsha vamet — hare zo petura. ben tesha shanim veyom echad shebba al yevimto, umishshehigdil nasa ishsha acheret, vamet, im lo yada et harishona mishshehigdil — harishona choletzet velo mityaybemet, vehashsheniyyay o choletzet o mityaybemet.
Rabbi shimon omer: meyaybem lee zo sheyyirtze, vecholetz lashsheniyyay. echad shehu ben tesha shanim veyom echad, veechad shehu ben esrim shello hevi shete searot.
Gemara amar rava: ha daamur rabbanan zikkat shene yevamin, michlatz chaltza yabbome la miyyabbema, la tema hecha deikka tzara, deikka lemigzar mishshum tzara.
Deha hacha lekka tzara, michlatz chaltza, yabbome la miyyabbema.
Nasa ishsha umet kulei. tenena leha detanu rabbanan: shote vekatan shennasu umetu — neshotehen peturot min hachalitza umin hayyibbum.

Ben tesha vechulei mishshehigdil vechulei. veyaasu biat ben tesha kemaamar baggadol, vetiddache tzara miyyibbum! amar rav: lo asu biat ben tesha kemaamar baggadol. ushemuel amar: asu veasu. vechen amar rabbi yochanan: asu veasu.
Veyaasu? tannae hi. hach tanna dearbaa achin gazar mishshum tzara.
Veashmeinan begadol, vehu haddin bekatan. vehay deamar gadol — mishshum divgadol kae.
Vehay tanna dehacha sevira leh asu, vela gazar mishshum tzara. veashmeinan bekatan, vehu haddin begadol. vehay dekaamar bekatan — divkatan kae.

Azal rabbi elazar amar lishmata be midresha, vela amra mishshemeh derabbi yochanan. shema rabbi yochanan ikkefad. ul legabbeh rabbi amme verabbi assi. amaru leh: lo kach haya hammaase bevet hakkeneset shel teverya beneger sheyyesh berosho gelostera,

Shennechleku bo rabbi elazar verabbi yose, ad shekkaru sefer tora bachamatan. karu salka datach?! ella ema shennikra sefer tora bachamatan. vehaya sham rabbi yose ben kisma, amar: tameah ani im lo yihye bet hakkeneset zo avoda zara. vechen hava.
Hadar ikkefad tefe, amar: chavruta name?!

Ul legabbeh rabbi yaakov bar idi. amar leh: "kaasher tzivva Adonai et moshe avdo ken tzivva moshe et yehoshua vechen asa yehoshua lo hesir davar mikkol asher tzivva Adonai et moshe", vechi al kol davar sheamar yehoshua haya omer lahem: kach amar li moshe? ella yehoshua yoshev vedoresh setam, vehakkol yodin shettorato shel moshe hi. af rabbi elazar talmidcha yoshev vedoresh setam, vehakkol yodin ki shellecha hi.

Amar lahem: mippene ma i attem yodin lefayyes keven idi chaverenu. verabbi yochanan may tama kafed kulle hay? deamar rav yehuda amar rav: may dichtiv: "agura beoholcha olamim", vechi efshar lo leadam lagur bishne olamim? ella amar david lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, yehi ratzon

a: Sheyyomru devar shemua mippi baolam hazze. deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: kol talmid chacham sheomrim devar shemua mippiv baolam hazze, siftotav dovvot bakkever. amar rabbi yitzchak ben zeera, veittema shimon nezira: may keraa — "vechikkech keyen hattov holech ledodi lemesharim dovev sifte yeshenim".
Kechomer shel anavim: ma komer shel anavim, kevan shemmanniach adam etzbao alav — miyyad dovev; af talmide chachamim, kevan sheomrim devar shemua mippihem baolam hazze — siftotehem dovvot bakkever.
Echad ben tesha shanim vechulei. ureminhu: ben esrim shana shello hevi shete searot — yaviu reaya shehu ben esrim, vehu hassaris — lo choletz velo meyaybem.
Bat esrim shana shello hevia shete searot — yaviu reaya shehi bat esrim, vehi haaylonit — lo choletzet velo mityaybemet.
Ha ittemar ala, amar rav shemuel bar yitzchak amar rav: vehu shennoldu lo simane saris. amar rava: dayka name, dekatane: vehu hassaris. shema minna.
Vechi lo noldu lo simane saris, ad kamma? tane deve rabbi chiyyay: ad rov shenotav.
Ki ato lekammeh derava, i kachush amar lehu: zilu avreyu. vei bari amar lehu: zilu achchashu. dehane simanin, zimnin denatri mechamat kechishuta, vezimnin denatri mechamat beriyyuta.
Hadaran alach haishsha rabba
Nosin al haanusa veal hamefutta, haones vehamefatte al hannesua — chayyayv. nose adam anusat aviv umefuttat aviv, anusat beno umefuttat beno. rabbi yehuda oser baanusat aviv umefuttat aviv.
Gemara tenena leha detanu rabbanan: anas ishsha — muttar lissa bittah, nasa ishsha — asur lissa bittah. ureminhu: hannitan min haishsha — asur beimmah uvevittah uvaachotah! midderabbanan.
Vechol hecha deikka issura midderabbanan tane nosin lechattechilla?! ki tenan matnitin — leachar mita.
Mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: bechullan neemar shechiva, vechan neemar kicha, lomar lecha: derech likkuchin asra tora.
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: ella meatta, gabbe achoto dichtiv: "ish asher yikkach et achoto bat aviv o vat immo", hachi name derech kicha hu daasir, derech shechiva shere?!
Amar leh: likkuchin ketivi battora setam. harauy lekicha — kicha, harauy lishchiva — shechiva.
Rava amar: anas ishsha — muttar lissa bittah mehacha, ketiv: "ervat bat bincha o vat bittecha lo tegalle", ha bat benah dida, uvat bittah dida — galli,
Uchetiv: "ervat ishsha uvittah lo tegalle et bat benah veet bat bittah lo tikkach", ha ketzad? kan baonasin, kan benissuin.
Efoch ana? arayot "sheer" ketiv behu. benissuin ikka sheer, baonasin lekka sheer.
Rabbi yehuda oser baanusat aviv vechulei. amar rav giddel amar rav: may tama derabbi yehuda, dichtiv: "lo yikkach ish et eshet aviv velo yegalle kenaf aviv", kanaf sheraa aviv lo yegalle.
Umimmay devaanusa ketiv — dichtiv meillaveh dikra: "venatan haish hashshochev immah laavi hannaara chamishshim kasef".

Verabbanan: i hava semich leh — kidkaamrat. hasheta dela semich leh, mibbee leh lechidrav anan. deamar rav anan amar shemuel: beshomeret yavam shel aviv hakkatuv medabber. umay "kenaf aviv" — kanaf harauy leaviv lo yegalle.
Vetippok leh mishshum dodato! laavor aleha bishne lavin.
Vetippok leh mishshum yevama lashshuk! laavor aleha bishlosha lavin. veibbaet ema: leachar mita.
b: "Ach meav velo meem, vehu baala deem, vaana beratta deinteteh". amar rame bar chama: dela kerabbi yehuda dematnitin.
"Ach hu, uveri hu, achateh ana dehay dedarena akkatpay" — mashkachat la begoy habba al bitto.
"Shelama lach beri, bat achatich ana" — mashkachat la begoy habba al bat bitto.
"Dallae dedalu davvla, lippol bechu setar petar: dehay dedarena hu bar, vaana berat achu" — mashkachat la begoy habba al bat beno.

"Biyyay biyyay meach, vehu av, vehu beel, vehu bar beel, vehu bala deem, vaana beratta deitteteh, vela yahev pitta laachu yatme bene veratte" — mashkachat la begoy habba al immo veholid mimmenna bat, vechazar uva al otah bat, vechazar zaken uva aleha veholid mimmenna banim.

"Ana veat — ache, ana vaavuch — ache, ana veimmach — ache" — mashkachat la begoy habba al immo veholid mimmenna shete vanot, vechazar uva al achat mehen, veholid mimmenna ben, vekarya leh achateh deimma vekaamra leh hachi.

"Ana veat — bene ache, ana vaavuch — bene ache, ana veimmach — bene ache". ha behettera name mashkachat la — kegon reuven sheyyesh lo shete vanot, vaata shimon unesav chada minnayyhu, vaata bar levi unesav chad minnayyhu, vekaamar leh bereh deshimon levar bereh delevi.

Mishna haggiyyoret shennitgayyeyru baneha immah lo — choltzin velo meyaybmin, afillu horato shel rishon shello bikdushsha veledato bikdushsha, vehashsheni horato veledato bikdushsha. vechen shifcha shennishtachreru baneha immah.
Gemara bene yudan amta ishtachrur, shera lehu rav acha bar yaakov leminsav neshe dahadade. amar leh rava: veha rav sheshet asar! amar leh: hu asar vaana sharena.
Min haav velo min haem — kulle alma la peligi dishre. min haem velo min haav — kulle alma la peligi daasir.
Ki peligi, min haav umin haem. man deshare: batar abba shadenan, deha "bene felanya" karu lehu. verav sheshet: karu lehu name "bene felonit".
Veikka deamar: pelig rav acha bar yaakov afillu beachin min haem, umay tama? ger shennitgayyer kekatan shennolad dame.
Tenan: haggiyyoret shennitgayyeyru baneha immah — lo choltzin velo meyaybmin. may tama, lav mishshum daasiri! la, deenah betorat chalitza veyibbum, vesharya lealma. veinhu name sheru.

Veha katane "afillu", i amrat bishlama asiri, hayeynu dekatane "afillu" — deaf al gav derishon horato shello bikdushsha veledato bikdushsha, vehashsheni horato veledato bikdushsha, vechishte immahot damu, afillu hachi — asiri. ella i amrat sharu, may "afillu"?
Deaf al gav detarvayyhu ledatan bikdushsha, veate leichallofe beyisrael, afillu hachi — shere.

Ikka deamri: hachi name mistabbera dishru, dekatane "afillu". i amrat bishlama sheru — hayeynu dekatane "afillu", deaf al gav detarvayyhu ledatan bikdushsha, deate leichallofe beyisrael — afillu hachi sheru. ella i amrat asiri, may "afillu"?
Deaf al gav derishon horato shello bikdushsha veledato bikdushsha, vehashsheni horato veledato bikdushsha, dechishte immahot dame — afillu hachi asiri.

Ta shema: shene achim teomim gerim, vechen meshucherarim — lo choltzin velo meyaybmin, veen chayyayvin mishshum eshet ach. hayta horatan shello bikdushsha veledatan bikdushsha — lo choltzin velo meyaybmin, aval chayyayvin mishshum eshet ach. hayta horatan veledatan bikdushsha — hare hen keyisreelim lechol divrehen. katane mihat: en chayyayvin mishshum eshet ach, chiyyuva lekka —

a: Ha issura ikka! hu haddin daafillu issura name lekka, veayyeyde devae lemitne sefa "aval chayyayvin", tanna name resha "en chayyayvin".
Amar rava, ha daamur rabbanan: en av legoy, la tema mishshum dishtivfi bezimma, dela yedia, aval yedia — chayyshinan, ella afillu didia — name la chayyshinan.

Deha shene achin teomim, detippa achat hi venechleka lishtayim, vekatane sefa: lo choltzin velo meyaybmin, shema minna: afkore afkereh rachamana lezareh, dichtiv: "besar chamorim besaram vezirmat susim zirmatam".

Ta shema, deamar rabbi yose: maase beniftayim hagger shennasa eshet achiv meimmo, uva maase lifne chachamim, veamru: en ishut lagger. veella ger dekaddesh hachi name la tafsi ba kiddushin?! ella ema: en issur eshet ach lagger. may lav denasva ach keshehu ger!
La, denasva keshehu goy. keshehu goy, may lememra? mahu detema: ligzor keshehu goy attu keshehu ger, ka mashma lan.

Ta shema, deamar ben yasyayn: keshehalachti lichrakke hayyam matzati ger echad shennasa eshet achiv meimmo. amarti lo: beni, mi hirshecha? amar li: hare ishsha veshiva baneha, al safsal ze yashav rabbi akiva veamar shene devarim: ger nose eshet achiv meimmo, veamar: "vayhi devar Adonai el yona shenit lemor" — shenit dibbera immo shechina, shelishit lo dibbera immo shechina. katane mihat ger nose eshet achiv meimmo. may lav, denasva achiv keshehu ger?
La, denasva keshehu goy. may lememra? mahu detema: nigzor keshehu goy attu keshehu ger, ka mashma lan.
Umi meheman, vehaamar rabbi abba amar rav huna amar rav: kol talmid chacham shemmore halacha uva, im kodem maase amarah — shomin lo, veim lav — en shomin lo!
Ibbaet ema: more uva haya. veibbaet ema: mishshum dekaamar hare ishsha veshiva baneha. veibbaet ema: shane hacha, dekaamar maase acharina bahade.

Amar mar: "vayhi devar Adonai el yona shenit lemor", shenit dibbera immo shechina, shelishit lo dibbera immo. veha ketiv: "hu heshiv [et] gevul yisrael millevo chamat ad yam haarava kidvar Adonai asher dibber beyad avdo yona ven amittay hannavi"!

Amar ravina: al iske ninve kaamar. rav nachman bar yitzchak amar, hachi kaamar: "kidvar Adonai asher dibber beyad avdo hannavi" — keshem shennehpach leninve meraa letova, kach bime yarovam ben yoash nehefach lahem leyisrael meraa letova.
Ta shema: ger shehaya ledato bikdushsha vehorato shello bikdushsha — yesh lo sheer haem, veen lo sheer haav. ketzad? nasa achoto min haem — yotzi. min haav — yekayyem. achot haav min haem — yotzi,
b: Min haav — yekayyem. achot haem min haem — yotzi, min haav — rabbi meir omer: yotzi, vachachamim omrim: yekayyem. shehaya rabbi meir omer: kol erva shehi mishshum sheer haem — yotzi, mishshum haav — yekayyem.
Umuttar beeshet achiv meimmo, uveeshet achi aviv. ushear kol haarayot muttarot lo. leetoye eshet haav.
Nasa ishsha uvittah — kones achat umotzi achat. lechattechilla lo yichnos. meta ishto — muttar bachamoto. veikka detane: asur bachamoto.
Katane mihat: muttar beeshet achiv, may lav, denasva achiv keshehu ger? la, denasva keshehu goy. may lememra? mahu detema: ligzor keshehu goy attu keshehu ger, ka mashma lan.

Amar mar: nasa ishsha uvittah — kones achat umotzi achat. lechattechilla lo yichnos. hasheta appoke mappek — lechattechilla mibbaya?! hatam kae, vehachi kaamar: hach daamur rabbanan yekayyem, lechattechilla lo yichnos.
Meta ishto — muttar bachamoto. veikka detane: asur bachamoto. chada kerabbi yishmael, vachada kerabbi akiva.

Man deasar, kerabbi yishmael, deamar: chamoto leachar mita — beissura kayyma, vegabbe ger gezaru beh rabbanan. uman deshare, kerabbi akiva, deamar: chamoto leachar mita — kelash leh issura, vegabbe ger la gezaru beh rabbanan.
Mishna chamesh nashim shennitarvu valdotehen, higdilu hattaarovot venasu nashim, umetu — arbaa choltzin leachat, veechad meyaybem otah.
Hu ushelosha choltzin leachat, veechad meyaybem. nimtzeu arba chalitzot veyibbum lechol achat veachat.
Gemara vedavka michlatz vahadar yabbome, aval yabbome beresha — la, dekafaga bivama lashshuk.
May hu ushelosha choltzin leachat? dela tema leyabbeminhu chad lechullehu, ella kol chad vechad meyaybem chada, dilma mitramya leh dideh.

Miktzatan achin umiktzatan sheen achin — haachin choltzin, vesheen achin meyaybmin. may kaamar? amar rav safra, hachi kaamar: miktzatan achin min haav umiktzatan achin min haem. achin min haem — choltzin, veachin min haav — meyaybmin.
Miktzatan kohanim umiktzatan sheenan kohanim — kohanim choltzin, sheenan kohanim — meyaybmin. miktzatan kohanim umiktzatan achin min haem — ellu vaellu choltzin velo meyaybmin.

a: Tanu rabbanan: yesh choletz leimmo missafek, laachoto missafek, levitto missafek.

Ketzad? immo veishsha acheret, velahen shene zecharim, vechazru veyaldu shene zecharim bemachave, uva benah shel zo venasa immo shel ze, uvenah shel zo nasa immo shel ze, umetu belo banim — ze choletz lishtehen, veze choletz lishtehen. nimtza kol echad veechad choletz leimmo missafek.
Laachoto missafek ketzad? immo veishsha acheret sheyyaldu shete nekevot bemachave, uvau achehen shello meotah haem unesaum, umetu belo banim — choletz lishtehen, nimtza choletz laachoto missafek.
Levitto missafek ketzad? ishto veishsha acheret sheyyaldu shete nekevot bemachave, uvau achehen unesaum, umetu belo banim — ze choletz levitto missafek, veze choletz levitto missafek.
Tanya, haya rabbi meir omer: ish veishsha peamim shemmolidin chamesh ummot.

Ketzad? yisrael shellakach eved veshifcha min hashshuk, velahen shene vanim, venitgayyer echad mehen — nimtza echad ger veechad goy. hitbilan leshem avdut venizkeku ze laze, hare kan ger vegoy veeved. shichrer et hashshifcha uva aleha haeved, hare kan ger vegoy veeved umamzer. shichrer shenehem, vehissian ze laze — hare kan ger vegoy veeved umamzer veyisrael.
May ka mashma lan — goy veeved habba al bat yisrael havvalad mamzer.

Tanu rabbanan: yesh mocher et aviv lehagebot immo ketubbatah. ketzad? yisrael lakach eved veshifcha min hashshuk velahem ben. veshichrer et hashshifcha unesaah, veamad vechatav kol nechasav livnah, nimtza ze mocher et aviv lehagebot leimmo ketubbatah.
May ka mashma lan? kulla rabbi meir hi, veavda mittaltele, umittaltele mishtabedi lichtuva. veibbaet ema: ha kamashma lan avda kimkarka dame.
Mishna haishsha shennitarev veladah bivlad kallatah, higdilu hattaarovot venasu nashim, umetu — bene hakkalla choltzin velo meyaybmin, shehu safek eshet achiv, safek eshet achi aviv.
Bene hazzekena o choltzin o meyaybmin, she[hu] safek eshet achiv veeshet ben achiv.
Metu hakkesherim, hattaarovot livne hazzekena choltzin velo meyaybmin, shehu safek eshet achiv veeshet achi aviv. livne hakkalla — echad choletz, veechad meyaybem.
Kohenet shennitarev veladah bivlad shifchatah — hare ellu ochlim bitruma — vecholkin chelek echad baggoren,
b: Veenan mittammein lemetim. veenan nosin nashim, ben kesherot ben pesulot. higdilu hattaarovot veshichreru ze et ze — nosin nashim reuyot lakkehunna.

Veenan metammein lemetim, veim nitmeu — enan sofgin haarbaim. veenan ochlin bitruma, veim achlu — enan meshallemin keren vachomesh. veenan cholkin al haggoren. umochrin et hatteruma, vehaddamim shellahen.
Veenan cholkin bekodshe hammikdash, veen notnim lahem kadashim. veen motziin shellahem midehem.
Ufeturin min hazzeroa umin hallechayayim umin hakkeva, uvechoro yehe roe ad sheyyistaev. venotnin alav chumere chohanim vechumere yisreelim.
Gemara metu hakkesherim vechulei. ella hanach, mishshum deiaruv lehu havu lehu pesulin? amar rav pappa, ema: umetu havvaddain.
Livne hakkalla echad choletz vechulei. davka michlatz vahadar yabbome, aval yabbome beresha — la, dekafaga bivama lashshuk.
Kohenet shennitarev vechulei. chelek echad peshita! ema chelek keechad.

Tenan keman deamar en cholkin teruma leeved ella im ken rabbo immo. detanya: en cholkin teruma leeved ella im ken rabbo immo, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer: yachol sheyyomar, im kohen ani — tenu li bishvil atzmi, veim eved kohen ani — tenu li bishvil rabbi.
Bimkomo shel rabbi yehuda hayu maalin mitteruma leyuchasin. bimkomo shel rabbi yose lo hayu maalin mitteruma leyuchasin.
Tanya, amar rabbi elazar bar tzadok: miyyamay lo headti ella edut echad, veheelu eved lakkehunna al pi.
Heelu salka datach?! hasheta behemtan shel tzaddikim en hakkadosh baruch hu mevi takkala al yadan, tzaddikim atzman lo kol shekken!
Ella ema: bikkeshu lehaalot eved lakkehunna al pi. chaza beatreh derabbi yose — vaazal veashed beatreh derabbi yehuda.

Tanu rabbanan: asara en cholkin lahem teruma bevet haggoranot, veellu hen: cheresh, shote, vekatan, tumetum, veanderoginos, vehaeved, vehaishsha, vehearel, vehattame, venose ishsha sheenah hogenet lo. vechullan meshaggerin lahem levattehem, chutz mittame venose ishsha sheenah hogenet lo.
Bishlama cheresh shote vekatan — lav bene dea ninhu. tumetum veanderoginos name —

a: Beriyya bifne atzmah ninhu. eved name — dilma ate leassoke mitteruma leyuchasin. arel vetame — mishshum dimisi. nose ishsha sheenah hogenet lo — mishshum kenasa. ella ishsha, may tama la?
Peligi ba rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua. chad amar: mishshum gerusha. vechad amar: mishshum yichud.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu be dare dimkarav lemata, vela shechichi behu inashe. i name: dimrachak, ushechichi be inashe.
Vechullan meshaggerin lahem levattehen, chutz mittame venose ishsha sheenah hogenet lo. aval arel meshaggerinan leh, may tama?
Mishshum daanis. tame name, ha anis? hay nefish uneseh, vehay la nefish uneseh.
Tanu rabbanan: haeved vehaishsha, en cholkin lahem teruma bevet haggoranot. uvemakom shecholkin — notnin laishsha techilla ufotrin otah miyyad. may kaamar?
Hachi kaamar: bemakom shecholkin masar ani — notnin leishsha techilla. may tama — mishshum ziluta.

Amar rava: meresha, ki havo atu gavra veitteta ledina kammay, hava sharena tigra degavra beresha. amena: demichayyayv bemitzvot. kevan dishmana leha, sharena tigra deitteta beresha. may tama? mishshum ziluta.
Higdilu hattaarovot vechulei. shichreru, i bae — in, i la bae — la, veammay? lissa shifcha eno yachol, bat chorin eno yachol! amar rava, ema: kofin otan, umeshachrerin ze et ze.

Notnin alehem chumere vechulei. lemay hilcheta? amar rav pappa: leminchatam nikmetzet keminchat yisrael veenah neechelet keminchat kohanim. ha ketzad? hakkometz karev beatzmo, vehashshirayim kerevin beatzman.
Ikkeri kan: kol shemmimmennu laishshim, hare hu beval taktiru".
Amar rabbi yehuda bereh derabbi shimon ben pazzi: demassek lehu leshum etzim, kerabbi elazar. detanya, rabbi elazar omer: "lereach nichoach" i atta maale, aval atta maale leshum etzim.

Hanicha lerabbi elazar. ella lerabbanan, may ikka lememar? deaved la kerabbi elazar berabbi shimon. detanya, rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer: hakkometz karev leatzmo, vehashshirayim mitpazzerin al bet haddeshen. vaafillu rabbanan la peligi aleh derabbi elazar berabbi shimon ella beminchat chote shel kohanim, devat hakerava hi, aval hacha — afillu rabbanan modu.

Mishna mi shello shahata achar baalah shelosha chodashim, venisset, veyalda, veen yadua im ben tisha larishon im bin shiva laacharon — hayu lah banim min harishon uvanim min hashsheni, choltzin velo meyaybmin. vechen hu lahem — choletz velo meyaybem.
b: Hayu lo achim min harishon veachim min hashsheni, shello meotah haem — hu choletz umeyaybem, vehem — echad choletz veechad meyaybem.

Haya echad yisrael veechad kohen — nose ishsha reuya lechohen, veen mittamme lemetim. veim nitma — eno sofeg et haarbaim. eno ochel bitruma, veim achal — eno meshallem keren vachomesh. veeno cholek al haggoren. umocher hatteruma, vehaddamim shello.

Veeno cholek bekodshe hakkodashim. veen notnin lo et hakkodashim, veen motziin et shello miyyado. ufatur min hazzeroa vehallechayayim vehakkeva. uvechoro yehe roe ad sheyyistaev. venotnin alav chumere kohanim vechumere yisreelim.
Hayu shenehem kohanim — hu onen alehem, vehem onnim alav. hu eno mittamme lahem, vehem enan metammeim lo. hu eno yoresh otan, aval hem yorshin oto.
Ufatur al makkato veal killato shel ze veshel ze. ole bemishmaro shel ze veshel ze, veeno cholek. im hayu shenehem bemishmar echad — notel chelek echad.
Gemara davka michlatz vahadar yabbome, aval yabbome beresha — la, deka faga bivama lashshuk.

Amar shemuel: asara kohanim omdim, uferash echad mehem, uvaal — havvalad shetuki. may "shetuki"? ilema shemmeshattekin oto minnichse aviv — peshita! mi yadinan avu mannu? ella shemmeshattekin oto middin kehunna.
May tama? amar kera: "vehayta lo ulezaro acharav", baenan zaro meyuchas acharav, velekka.

Matkef la rav pappa: ella meatta gabbe avraham, dichtiv: "lihyot lecha lelohim ulezaracha acharecha", hatam may ka mazhar leh rachamana? hachi kaamar leh: la tinsav goya veshifcha, dela lezil zarach batra.

Metivi: rishon rauy lihyot kohen gadol. veha baenan zaro meyuchas acharav, velekka! zaro meyuchas acharav — derabbanan, ukera asmachta bealma. vechi gezur rabbanan — biznut, benissuin la gezur rabbanan.
Uviznut mi gezur rabbanan? vehatnan: mi shello shahata achar balah shelosha chodashim venisset veyalda.

May "achar balah"? ilema achar mitat balah, ema sefa: hu onen alehem, vehem onnim alav. bishlama hu onen alehem — mashkachat la benissuin desheni velikkut atzamot dekamma. ella: hem onnim alav, hechi mashkachat la? kamma ha mit leh!

Veella bigrusha, umay "achar balah" — achar get balah. ema sefa: hu en mittamme lahem vehem enan mittammein lo. bishlama hen en mittammein lo — lechumera, dechol chad vechad dilma lav bereh hu. ella hu en mittamme lahem, ammay?
Bishlama lesheni la littamme leh, ella lerishon littamme leh mimma nafshach? i bereh hu — shappir ka mittamme leh, vei bar batra hu — shappir ka mittamme leh, dechalal hu.
Ella lav, biznut. umay "achar balah" — achar boalah. vekatane sefa: ole bemishmar shel ze veshel ze. uteyuveta dishmuel!
Amar rav shemaya: bimmaenet.

Memaenet mi ka yalda? vehatane rav bivi kammeh derav nachman: shalosh nashim meshammeshot bemoch: ketanna, meubberet, umenika. ketanna — shemma titabber vetamut, meubberet — shemma taase ubbarah sandal, menika — shemma tigmol et benah veyamut. veezo hi ketanna — mibbat achat esre shana veyom echad ad bat shetem esre shana veyom echad. pachot mikken o yater al ken — meshammeshet kedarkah veholechet, divre rabbi meir.
Vachachamim omrim: achat zo veachat zo meshammeshet kedarkah veholechet, umin hashshamayim yerachamu. shenneemar: "shomer petaim Adonai"!
Mashkachat la bekiddushe taut, vechidrav yehuda amar shemuel. deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel mishshum rabbi yishmael: "vehi lo nitpasa" — asura, ha nitpasa — mutteret.
Veyesh lecha acheret, sheaf al pi shello nitpasa, mutteret. vee zo — zo shekkiddusheha kiddushe taut, sheafillu benah murekav lah al ketefah — memaenet veholechet lah.

a: Hayu shenehem kohanim vechulei. tanu rabbanan: hikka ze vechazar vehikka ze, killel ze vechazar vekillel ze, killel shenehem bevat achat, hikka shenehem bevat achat — chayyayv. rabbi yehuda omer: bevat achat — chayyayv, baze achar ze — patur.
Vehatanya, rabbi yehuda omer: patur bevat achat! tere tannae allibba derabbi yehuda.
May tama deman defatar? amar rabbi chanina: neemra beracha lematta, veneemra beracha lemala. ma lemala sheen bah shuttafut — af lematta sheen bah shuttafut. veittakkash hakkaa liklala.
Veole bemishmaro vechulei. vechi meachar deeno cholek, lamma ole? lamma ole?! haamar: baena denebed mitzva! ella: "ala" la katane, ella "ole" — beal korcho.
Amar rav acha bar chanina amar abbaye amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: mishshum pegam mishpacha.
Veim hayu shenehem bemishmar kulei. may shena shene mishmarot dela — deazel leha mishmara umedachu leh, veazel leha mishmara umedachu leh. mishmar echad name: azel lehay bet av umedachu leh!
Amar rav pappa, hachi kaamar: im hayu shenehem mishmar echad uvet av echad — notel chelek echad.
Hadaran alach nosin al haanusa
Mitzvat chalitza bishlosha dayyaynin, vaafillu shelashtan hedyotot. chaltza beminal — chalitzatah keshera, beanpilya — chalitzatah pesula. besandal sheyyesh lo akev — kasher, vesheen lo akev — pesul.

Min haarkubba ulematta — chalitza keshera. min haarkubba ulemala — chalitza pesula. chaltza besandal sheen shello, o besandal shel etz, o beshel semol beyamin — chalitza keshera. chaltza begadol shehu yachol lahaloch bo, o bekatan shehu chofe et rov raglo — chalitzatah keshera.

Gemara umeachar daafillu shelosha hedyotot, dayyaynin lema li? ha ka mashma lan devaenan bishlosha sheyyodim lehakerot keen dayyaynim. tenena leha detanu rabbanan: mitzvat chalitza bishlosha sheyyodin lehakerot keen dayyaynim. rabbi yehuda omer: bachamishsha.

May tama detanna kamma, detanya: "zekenim" — shenayim, veen bet din shakul, mosifin alehen od echad — hare kan shelosha. verabbi yehuda: "zikne" — shenayim, "zekenim" — shenayim, veen bet din shakul, mosifin alehen od echad — hare kan chamishsha.
Vetanna kamma, hay "zikne" may aved leh? mibbee leh lerabboye afillu shelosha hedyotot.
Verabbi yehuda, hedyotot mena leh? nafka leh milleene", deamar mar: "leene" — perat lesomim,

Umiddeitzterich "leene" lemaote somim, shema minna daafillu hedyotot. dei salka datach sanhedrin baenan, lema li lemaote somin? middetane rav yosef nafka, detane rav yosef: keshem shebbet din menukkim betzedek, kach bet din menukkim mikkol mum,
b: Shenneemar: "kullach yafa rayati umum en bach". veiddach: hahu "leene" may aved leh? hahu lechidrava hu daata. deamar rava: tzerichi dayyayne lemichze rukka deka nafek mippumma divama, dichtiv: "leene hazzekenim ... veyarka".
Veiddach name, mibbee leh lechidrava! in hachi name, veella hedyotot mena leh? nafka mibbeyisrael" — yisrael kol dehu.
Veiddach, hay "yisrael" may aved leh? mibbee leh lechidtane rav shemuel bar yehuda: "beyisrael" — bevet din shel yisrael, velo bevet din shel gerim.

Veiddach? "beyisrael" acharina ketiv. veiddach? mibbee leh lechidtanya, amar rabbi yehuda: paam achat hayinu yoshvin lifne rabbi tarfon, uvaa yevama lachlotz, veamar lanu, anu kullechem: "chalutz hannaal".
Veiddach? mivvenikra" nafka.
Ella meatta, "vekaru" — shenayim, "vedibberu" shenayim! hachi name, lerabbi yehuda hare kan tisha, lerabbanan hare kan shiva!

Hahu mibbee leh lechidtanya: "vekaru lo" — velo shelucham, "vedibberu elav" — melammed shemmassiin lo etza hahogenet lo. sheim haya hu yeled vehi zekena, hu zaken vehi yalda, omrim lo: ma lecha etzel yalda, ma lecha etzel zekena? kelach etzel shekkemotcha, veal tachnis ketata letoch betcha.
Amar rava amar rav nachman: halacha, chalitza bishlosha, hoil usetam lan tena kevoteh. amar leh rava lerav nachman: i hachi, meun name, ditnan: hammeun vehachalitza bishlosha.

Vechi tema: hachi name, vehatanya: meun, bet shammay omrim bet din mumechin, uvet hillel omrim: bevet din veshello bevet din. ellu veellu modim shetztzarich shelosha. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda verabbi elazar berabbi yose machshirin bishnayim. veamar rav yosef bar minyome amar rav nachman: halacha keoto hazzug.
Hatam chad setama, vehacha tere setame. hatam name tere setame ninhu, ditnan: meana o shechaltza befanav — yissaenna, mippene shehu bevet din.
Ella, hatam tere setame hacha telata setame.
Mikkede ha setama veha setama, ma li chad setam, ma li tere setam, ma li telata? ella, amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: hoil usetam bimkom machloket,

Ditnan: semichat zekenim veegla arufa bishlosha, divre rabbi yose. rabbi yehuda omer: bachamishsha. hachalitza vehammeunin bishlosha, vela kafaleg rabbi yehuda — shema minna hadar beh rabbi yehuda. shema minna.

Amar rava: tzerichi dayyayne lemikba ducheta, dichtiv: "vealta yevimto hashshara el hazzekenim". rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua avdi ovada bechamsha. keman — kerabbi yehuda, veha hadar beh! lefirsome milleta.

Rav ashe ikkela leve rav kahana, amar leh: selek mar legabban lemalloye be chamsha. amar rav kahana: hava kaemna kammeh derav yehuda, vaamar li: ta sak lezirza dikne, leitzterofe be chamsha. amru lo: lema li chamsha? amar lehu: ki hechi delipparsam milleta.

Rav shemuel bar yehuda hava kae kammeh derav yehuda, amar leh: sak ta lezirza dikne leitzterofe be chamsha, lefarsome milleta. amar leh, tenena: "beyisrael" — bevet din yisrael velo bevet din shel gerim, vaana ger ana.
Amar rav yehuda: kegon rav shemuel bar yehuda, mappekna mamona appummeh. mappekna salka datach? veha "al pi shenayim edim" amar rachamana! ella: marana shetara appummeh.
Amar rava:

a: Ger dan et chavero devar tora, shenneemar: "som tasim alecha melech asher yivchar Adonai elohecha bo mikkerev achecha tasim alecha melech". "alecha" hu devaenan "mikkerev achecha", aval ger dan et chavero ger.
Veim hayta immo miyyisrael — dan afillu yisrael. uleinyan chalitza ad sheyyehe aviv veimmo miyyisrael, shenneemar: "venikra shemo beyisrael".
Amar rabba amar rav kahana amar rav: im yavo eliyyahu veyomar: "choltzin beminal" — shomin lo. "en choltzin besandal" — en shomin lo, shekkevar nahagu haam besandal.
Verav yosef amar rav kahana amar rav: im yavo eliyyahu veyomar: "en choltzin beminal" — shomin lo. "en choltzin besandal" — en shomin lo, shekkevar nahagu haam besandal.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu minal lechattechilla.
Uleman deamar afillu lechattechilla, vehatnan: chaltza beminal — chalitzatah keshera. diavad in, lechattechilla la!
Hu haddin daafillu lechattechilla. veayyeyde devae lemitne sefa beanpilya chalitzatah pesula, daafillu diavad, tena name resha diavad.

Uminal lechattechilla tannae hi. detanya, amar rabbi yose: paam achat halachti lintzivin, matzati zaken echad. amarti lo: kelum atta baki berabbi yehuda ben betera? amar li: hen, veal shulechani hu tadir. kelum raita shechalatz bivama?

Amar li: raiti shechalatz harebe peamim. beminal o besandal? amar li: vechi choltzin beminal?! (vehattora amra "naalo", velo minalo), amarti lo: im ken, ma raa rabbi meir lomar chaltza beminal chalitzatah keshera?!
Rabbi yaakov omer mishshemo: choltzin beminal lechattechilla. uman deamar lechattechilla la, may tama?
Illema mishshum dehavya panta meal vearketa meal demeal, vehattora amra "meal", velo meal demeal — i hachi, afillu diavad name la!
Gezera mishshum minal meruppat.
I name mishshum chatzi minal.

Amar rav: i lav dachameteh lechabbivi dachalatz besandal deit le shintzin, ana la havay chaletzna ella besandala detayyaya demihaddak tefe. vehay didan, af al gav deit beh chumarta, katrinan beh mitna, ki hechi detehve chalitzatah meallayyta.
Siman: hattarat yevama sandal. amar rav yehuda amar rav: hattarat yevama lashshuk — bishmitat rov heakev.
Metivi: hutteru retzuot minal vesandal, o sheshshamat rov haregel — chalitzatah pesula.
Tama deshamat hu, ha shamta hi — chalitzatah keshera. rov haregel in, rov heakev la!
Lo: hayeynu rov haregel, hayeynu rov heakev. veammay karu leh rov haregel — dechulla cheyla dechara aleh dechis.

Mesayyay leh lerabbi yannay: deamar rabbi yannay ben shehittir hu veshamta hi, ben shehittira hi veshamat hu — chalitzatah pesula, ad shettattir hi vetashmit hi. bae rabbi yannay: keraathu, mahu? serafathu, mahu? galloye kara baenan, vehaikka? o dilma chalitza baenan, velekka? teku.

Bea minneh rabbi nechemya merabba: shene minalim ze al gav ze, mahu? hechi dame: illema dishlafteh leillay vekae tattay — "meal" amar rachamana, velo meal demeal. la tzericha: dikrateh leillay ushelafteh letattay, vekae illay, may? chalitza baenan, veha ikka? o dilma galloye kara baenan, velekka?
b: Umi ikka ki hay gavvna? in, dechazyu rabbanan lerav yehuda dinfak bechamsha zuze moke leshuka.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: yevama shehigdila ben haachin — mutteret linnase leechad min haachin, veen choshshin shemma chaltza sandal leechad mehen. tama, dela chazenan, ha chazenan — chayyshinan.

Veha tanya: ben shennitkavvevn hu velo nitkavvevna hi, ben shennitkavvevna hi velo nitkavvevn hu — chalitzatah pesula, ad sheyyitkavvevnu shenehem keechad! hachi kaamar: af al gav dachazenan — en choshshin shemma kivvevnu.
Veikka deamri: tama, dela chazenan, ha chazenan — choshshin. udeka tane bae kauona — hane mille leishteroye lealma, aval leachin mippasla.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: sandal hattafur befishtan — en choltzin bo, shenneemar: "vaenalech tachash". veema: tachash — in, midde acharina — la! "naal" "naal" ribba.
I "naal" "naal" ribba, afillu kol mille name! im ken, "tachash" may ahani leh?
Bea minneh rabbi elazar merav: hu shel or, uteresiyyotav shel sear, mahu? amar leh: mi la karenan beh "vaenalech tachash"? i hachi, kullo shel sear name! hahu kurka mikkere.
Amar leh rav kahana lishmuel: mimmay dehay "vechaltza naalo meal raglo" mishlaf hu — dichtiv: "vechilletzu et haavanim asher bahen hannaga".
Veema zaroze hu, dichtiv: "hechaltzu meittechem anashim latztzava"! hatam name — shallofe mibbeta likrava.
Vehachtiv: "yechalletz ani veonyo"! bischar onyo, yechalletzo middinah shel gehinnam.
Ella ha dichtiv: "chone malach Adonai saviv lireav vaychalletzem"! bischar yereav yechalletzem middinah shel gehinnam.

Ella ha dichtiv: "veatzmotecha yachalitz", veamar rabbi elazar: zo meulla shebbabberachot, veamar rava: zaroze garme! in, mashma hachi umashma hachi. dehacha, i salka datach zaroze hu, im ken, lichtov rachamana "vechaltza naalo beraglo"!

I ketav rachamana "beraglo", hava amena: "beraglo" — in, beshoko — la, ketav rachamana "meal raglo" daafillu beshoko. im ken, lichtov rachamana "bemeal raglo". may "meal raglo" — shema minna mishlaf hu.
Amar leh hahu mina lerabban gamliel: amma dachalatz leh mareh minneh, dichtiv: "betzonam uvivkaram yelchu levakkesh et Adonai velo yimtzau chalatz mehem".
Amar leh: shote, mi ketiv "chalatz lahem"? "chalatz mehem" ketiv, veillu yevama dechaltzu lah achin — midde meshasha it beh?
Beanpilya chalitzatah pesula kulei. lememra deanpilya lav minal hu?
Utenan name: en hattorem nichnas lo befargod chafut velo beanpilya, veen tzarich lomar beminal vesandal, lefi sheen nichnasin beminal vesandal laazara.
Ureminhu: echad minal vesandal veanpilya, lo yetayyel bahen, lo mibbayit levayit velo mimmitta lemitta!

Amar abbaye: deit beh ketite, umishshum taanug. amar leh rava: umishshum taanug belo minal beyom hakkippurim mi asiri? veha rabba bar rav huna karech sudara akkareh venafek! ella amar rava: la kashya, kan beanpilya shel or, kan beanpilya shel beged.

Hachi name mistabbera, dei la tema hachi, kashya yom hakkippurim ayyom hakkippurim. detanya: lo yetayyel adam bekordakesin betoch beto, aval metayyel hu beanpilin betoch beto! ella lav shema minna: kan beanpilya shel or, kan beanpilya shel beged — shema minna.

Tanya kevoteh derava: chaltza beminal hannifram shechofe et rov haregel, besandal hannifchat shemmekabbel et rov haregel, besandal shel shaam veshel siv, bekav hakkittea, bemuk, bismichat haraglayim, beanpilya shel or, vehacholetzet min haggadol,

a: Ben omed, ben yoshev, ben mutte, vehacholetzet min hassome — chalitzatah keshera. aval beminal hannifram sheen chofe et rov haregel, besandal hannifchat sheeno mekabbel et rov haregel, uvismichat hayyadayim, uveanpilya shel beged, vecholetzet min hakkatan — chalitzatah pesula.
Kav hakkittea, manni — rabbi meir hi, ditnan: hakkittea yotze bekav shello, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose oser.
Beanpilya shel beged, atan lerabbanan!
Amar abbaye: middesefa rabbanan, resha name rabbanan. veresha, bimchuppe or.
Amar leh rava: aval en mechuppe or, may — pasul? i hachi, addetane sefa beanpilya shel beged, liflog bedida: bamme devarim amurim: bimchuppe or, aval en mechuppe or — pasul!
Ella amar rava: midderesha rabbi meir, sefa name rabbi meir: hay — maggen, vehay — la maggen.
Amar ammemar: hay man dechaletz, tzarich lemidchaseh lechareh.
Amar leh rav ashe leammemar, vehatanya: ben omed, ben yoshev, ben mutte! ema: uleolam dedaches lechareh.
Veamar ammemar: hay man dimsagge al lichata dechareh, la chaletz. amar leh rav ashe leammemar, vehatanya: semichut haraglayim, lav dechaletz ba ihu? la, deyahev leh leacher vechaletz.
Amar rav ashe: lemay dekaamar ammemar, lav bar ova chaletz, velav bar kifof chaletz.
Min haarkubba ulematta kulei. ureminhi: regalim — perat levaale kabbin!
Shane hacha, dichtiv: "meal raglo". i hachi, lemala min haarkubba name! "meal", vela meal demeal.

Amar rav pappa: shema minna, hay istavira ad ara nachet. dei salka datach mifsak pasek, have leh ihu "meal", veshoka meal demeal! amar rav ashe: afillu tema mifsak pasek, kol devahade kara — kechara dame.
Min haarkubba ulemala. metiv rav kahana: "uveshilyatah hayyotzet mibben ragleha"! amar abbaye: beshaa shekkoraat leled, noetzet akeveha beyarchoteha veyoledet.
Ta shema: "lo asa raglav velo asa sefamo"! lishshana mealleya. ta shema: "vayyavo shaul lehasech et raglav"! lishshana mealleya.
Ta shema: "ach mesich hu raglav bachadar hammekera"! lishshana mealleya. "ben ragleha kulei"! lishshana mealleya.

Amar rabbi yochanan: sheva beilot baal oto rasha beoto hayyom, shenneemar: "ben ragleha kara nafal shachav ben ragleha kara nafal baasher kara sham nafal shadud". veha ka mithanya meavera! amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: kol tovatan shel reshaim —
b: Raa hi etzel tzaddikim. shenneemar: "hishshamer lecha pen tedabber im yaakov mittov ad ra", bishlama ra — lechayye, ella tov ammay la? ella shema minna: tovatan shel reshaim — raa hi etzel tzaddikim.
Bishlama hatam, dilma madkar leh shema daavoda zara. ella hacha, may raa ikka?
Deka shade bah zuhama. deamar rabbi yochanan: beshaa shebba nachash al chavva hetil bah zuhama. yisrael, sheamdu al har sinay — paska zuhamatan. goyim, shello amdu behar sinay — lo paska zuhamatan.
Chaltza beminal sheeno shello vechulei. tanu rabbanan: "naalo", en li ella naalo. naal shel kol adam, minnayin? talmud lomar: "naal" — naal mikkol makom.
Im ken, ma talmud lomar "naalo"? naalo harauy lo. perat legadol sheen yachol lahaloch bo, uferat lekatan sheeno chofe rov raglo, uferat lesandal hamesuleyaym sheen lo akev.
Abbaye hava kae kammeh derav yosef, atay yevama lachlotz. amar leh: hav leh sandalach, yehayv leh sandala dismala, amar leh: emar daamur rabbanan, diavad, lechattechilla mi amur?
Amar leh: i hachi, sandal sheen shello name: emar daamur rabbanan diavad, lechattechilla mi amur? amar leh: hachi kaamena lach: hav leh veakni leh.
Sandal shel etz. man tanna? amar shemuel: rabbi meir hi, ditnan: hakkittea yotze bekav shello, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose oser. avu dishmuel omer: bimchuppe or, vedivre hakkol.
Amar rav pappi mishshemeh derava: sandal hammusegar — lo tachalotz bo, veim chaltza — chalitzatah keshera. sandal hammuchelat — lo tachalotz bo, veim chaltza — chalitzatah pesula.
Rav pappa mishshemeh derava amar: echad sandal hammusegar veechad sandal hammuchelat — lo tachalotz bo, veim chaltza — chalitzatah keshera.
Metivi: bayit hammusegar — metamme mittocho. muchelat — mittocho umeachorav. veze vaze metammein bevia.
Vei salka datach kedimchattat dame — veha baenan: "vehabba el habbayit", velekka!
Shane hatam, deamar kera: "venatatz et habbayit", afillu bishat netitza karuy bayit.
