Ta shema: matlet sheyyesh bo shalosh al shalosh, af al pi sheen bo kezayit, kevan shennichnas rubbah levayit tahor — timmeathu. may lav, mucheletet? la, musegeret.
I hachi, ema sefa: hayu bah kamma zetim, kevan shennichnas mimmenna kezayit levayit tahor — timmeathu,
I amrat bishlama mucheletet, hayeynu deittakkash lemet. ella i amrat musegeret, ammay ittakkash lemet?
Shane hatam, deamar kera: "vesaraf et habbeged", afillu bishat serefa karuy beged.
Veligmar minneh! issur mittumea la gamrinan.
Amar rava, hilcheta: echad sandal hammusegar, veechad sandal hammuchelat, veechad sandal shel avoda zara — lo tachlotz, veim chaltza — chalitzatah keshera. shel tikrovet avoda zara,

a: Veshel ir hanniddachat, veshel zaken heasuy lichvodo — lo tachlotz, veim chaltza — chalitzatah pesula.
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: may shena zaken heasuy lichvodo — delav lehillucha avid, deve dina name — lav lehillucha avid!
Amar leh: illu mesagge beh shelucha deve dina, mi kafed aleh dayyayna?
Mishna chaltza ballayla — chalitzatah keshera, verabbi elazar posel. bismol — chalitzatah pesula, verabbi elazar machshir.
Gemara lema beha kamippalgi: demar savar makkeshinan rivim lingaim, umar savar la makkeshinan rivim lingaim?

La: dechulle alma la makkeshinan rivim lingaim, dei makkeshinan — afillu gemar din ballayla name la, vehacha beha kamippalgi: mar savar: chalitza kitchillat din damya, umar savar: chalitza kigmar din damya.
Rabba bar chiyyay ketosfaa avad ovada bemuk, uvichidi, uvallayla. amar shemuel: kamma rav guvereh deaved kichidaa.
May kashya? i muk — setama tanya. i layla — setama tanya.

Ella yechidi ka kashya leh: hechi aved bichidi, dichidaa katane la. ditnan: chaltza bishnayim o bishlosha venimtza echad mehen karov o pasul — chalitzatah pesula. verabbi shimon verabbi yochanan hassandelar machshirim. umaase beechad shechalatz beno levenah bevet haasurim, uva maase lifne rabbi akiva vehichshir.

Veamar rav yosef bar minyome [amar rav nachman]: en halacha keoto hazzug. veibbaet ema: kullehu name yechidaa katane lehu. detanya, amar rabbi yishmael berabbi yose: ani raiti et rabbi yishmael ben elisha shechalatz bemuk, bichidi, uvallayla.
Bismol chalitzatah kulei. may tama derabbanan? amar ulla: yalfinan "regel" "regel" mimmetzora. ma lehallan deyamin, af kan deyamin.

Verabbi elazar la yalef "regel" "regel" mimmetzora? vehatanya, rabbi elazar omer: minnayin lirtzia shehi beozen hayemanit? neemar kan "ozen", veneemar lehallan "ozen". ma lehallan yamin, af kan yamin!
Amar rav yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yochanan: muchelefet hashshita.
Rava amar: leolam la tefoch, "ozen" "ozen" mufene, "regel" "regel" la mufene.
Vechi la mufene, may pircha ikka? ikka lemifrach: ma limtzora, shekken taun etz erez veezov usheni tolaat.

Mishna chaltza verakka, aval lo kara — chalitzatah keshera. kara verakka, aval lo chaltza — chalitzatah pesula. chaltza vekara, aval lo rakka — rabbi eliezer omer: chalitzatah pesula, rabbi akiva omer: chalitzatah keshera.
b: Amar rabbi eliezer: "kacha yease" — kol davar shehu maase meakkev. amar leh rabbi akiva: mishsham reaya? "kacha yease laish" — kol davar shehu maase baish.

Hacheresh shennechlatz, vehachereshet shechaltza, vecholetzet lekatan — chalitzatah pesula. ketanna shechaltza — tachlotz mishshettagdil, veim lo chaltza — chalitzatah pesula. chaltza bishnayim o bishlosha, venimtza echad mehen karov o pasul — chalitzatah pesula. rabbi shimon verabbi yochanan hassandelar machshirin. umaase beechad shechalatz beno levenah bevet haasurim, uva maase lifne rabbi akiva vehichshir.
Gemara amar rava: hasheta deamrat keria la meyakkeva, lefichach illem veillemet shechaltzu — chalitzatan keshera.
Tenan: cheresh shennechlatz, vehachereshet shechaltza, vehacholetzet min hakkatan — chalitzatah pesula. may tama — lav mishshum dela bene keriyyay ninhu! la, mishshum delav bene dea ninhu.
I hachi, illem veillemet name! amar rava: illem veillemet bene dea ninhu, ufummayyhu hu dechaev lehu.
Veha amri deve rabbi yannay: lefi sheeno beamar" "veamra"! ella, ki ittemar derava assefa ittemar: cheresh shennechlatz, vehachereshet shechaltza, vehacholetzet min hakkatan — chalitzatah pesula.
Amar rava: hasheta deamrat keriyyay meakkeva, lefichach illem veillemet shechaltzu — chalitzatan pesula. umatnitin kerabbi zera.
Deamar rabbi zera: kol harauy levilla — en billa meakkevet bo. vechol sheen rauy levilla — billa meakkevet.
Shelachu leh laavu dishmuel: yevama sherakka — tachlotz. mikkelal deippasla la meachin.
Manni? ilema rabbi akiva, hasheta uma bimkom mitzva, deikka lememar midde dehave aemurim, dechi letanhu — la meakkevi,
Vechi itanhu — meakkevi,
Amar rabbi akiva la meakkeva, meachin ippasla?
Veella lerabbi elazar —
Veha shene devarim hammattirin ninhu, ushene devarim hammattirin — en maalin ze belo ze.
Ella kerabbi. detanya: kivse atzeret — en mekaddeshin hallechem ella bishchita.

Ketzad? shechatan lishman, vezarak daman lishman — kadash hallechem. shachat shello lishman, vezarak lishman — lo kadash hallechem. shechatan lishman, vezarak daman shello lishman — kadosh veeno kadosh, divre rabbi.
Rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer: leolam eno kadosh ad sheyyishchot lishman veyizrok daman lishman.
Umi amar rabbi akiva rekika la pasla? vehatanya: chaltza velo

a: Rakka velo kara — chalitzatah keshera, rakka velo chaltza velo kara — chalitzatah pesula. kara velo rakka velo chaltza — en kan bet mechosh.

Manni? ilema rabbi eliezer: chaltza velo rakka velo kara chalitzatah keshera? veha amar rabbi eliezer: "kacha yease", davar shehu maase meakkev! ella peshita rabbi akiva, vekatane: rakka velo chaltza velo kara — chalitzatah pesula. leman?
Ilema lealma, peshita! mi havya chalitza deishtarya lealma? ella lav laachin, shema minna.
Ulerabbi akiva, may shena rekika umay shena keriyyay?
Keriyyay, deita ben battechilla ben bassof — la michallefa leh. rekika, devitchilla leta velivsof ita — michallefa leh, veatu lemishre chalutza laachin.

Veikka deamri, hachi shelachu leh: yevamah sherakka — tachlotz, veenah tzericha larok paam acheret. ki hahi daatay lekammeh derabbi amme, hava yatev rabbi abba bar memel kammeh. rekaka mikkamme detachlotz. amar leh rabbi amme: chalotz la, ushere la tigra.
Amar leh rabbi abba: veha baenan merak! ha rekaka la. veterok, uma bechach? nafek minneh chureba, dei amrat tihdar veterok, amri: rekika kammayyta let ba meshasha, veate lemishre chalutza laachin.
Veha baenan kesidran! kesidran la meakkeva. hu savar: dachoye ka medache leh. nefak, dak veashkach, detanya: ben shehikdim chalitza lirkika, ben shehikdim rekika lachalitza — ma sheasa asuy.
Levi nefak lekiryayta. beo minne: giddemet, mahu shettachlotz? yevama sherakka dam, mahu? "aval aggid lecha et harashum bichtav emet" — mikkelal deikka ketav sheeno emet?
La hava bideh. ata shael be midresha, amaru leh: mi ketiv "vechaltza bayyad"? umi ketiv "veyarka rok"?
"Aval aggid lach harashum bichtav emet", vechi yesh ketav sheeno emet?
La kashya: kan bigzar din sheyyesh immo shevua. kan bigzar din sheen immo shevua.

Kidrav shemuel bar amme. deamar rav shemuel bar amme amar rabbi yonatan: minnayin ligzar din sheyyesh immo shevua sheeno mitkarea, shenneemar: "lachen nishbati levet eli im yitkapper avon bet eli bezevach uvemincha ad olam".

Amar rabba: bezevach uvemincha eno mitkapper, aval mitkapper hu bedivre tora. abbaye amar: bezevach uvemincha eno mitkapper, aval mitkapper bigmilut chasadim. rabba veabbaye middevet eli kaatu, rabba daasak battora — chaya arbein shenin, abbaye daasak betora uvigmilut chasadim — chaya shittin shenin.

Tanu rabbanan: mishpacha achat hayta birushalayim shehayu metim keven shemone esre shana. bau vehodiu et rabban yochanan ben zakkay. amar lahem: shemma mimmishpachat eli attem, shenneemar: "vechol marbit betcha yamutu anashim" — lechu veisku battora vetichyu. halchu veasku battora vechayu, vehayu korin otan "mishpachat yochanan" al shemo.
Amar rav shemuel bar uneya amar rav: minnayin ligzar din shel tzibbur sheeno nechtam? eno nechtam?! veha ketiv: "ki im techabbesi banneter vetarbi lach borit nichtam avonech lefanay"!
Ella: minnayin sheafillu nechtam mitkarea — shenneemar: "mi chaAdonai elohenu bechol korenu elav", vehachtiv: "dirshu Adonai behimmatzo"! la kashya: ha beyachid, ha betzibbur.
Yachid emat? amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: ellu asara yamim shebben rosh hashshana leyom hakkippurim.
Shelachu leh laavu dishmuel: yevama sherakka dam — tachlotz, lefi shei efshar laddam belo tzichtzuach rok.
Metivi: yachol yehe dam hayyotze mippiv umippi haamma tame — talmud lomar: "zovo tame", veen dam hayyotze mippiv umippi haamma tame, ella tahor.
La kashya: kan bemotzetzet, kan beshotet.
Cheresh shennechlatz vechulei.
b: Amar rav yehuda amar rav: zo divre rabbi meir, aval chachamim omrim: en chalitzat katan kelum.
Ketanna shechaltza vechulei. amar rav yehuda amar rav: zo divre rabbi meir, deamar: "ish" katuv bapparasha, umakkeshinan ishsha leish.
Aval chachamim omrim: "ish" ketiv bapparasha. ishsha — ben gedola ben ketanna.

Man chachamim? rabbi yose hi. derabbi chiyyay verabbi shimon bar rabbi havo yatvi. petach chad minnayyhu vaamar: hammitpallel, tzarich sheyyitten enav lematta, shenneemar: "vehayu enay velibbi sham kol hayyamim".

Vechad amar: enav lemala, shenneemar: "nissa levavenu el kappayim". addehachi ata rabbi yishmael berabbi yose legabbayyhu. amar lehu: bemay askitu? amaru leh: bitfilla. amar lehu: kach amar abba: hammitpallel tzarich sheyyitten enav lematta velibbo lemala, kede sheyyitkayyeymu shene mikraot hallalu.
Addehachi, ata rabbi limtivta. inhu dahavo kallile, yetivu beduchetayyhu. rabbi yishmael berabbi yose, aggav yukereh hava mefassa veazel.
Amar leh abbadan: mi hu ze shemmefassea al rashe am kadosh! amar leh: ani yishmael berabbi yose shebbati lilmod tora merabbi. amar leh: vechi atta hagun lilmod tora merabbi?

Amar leh: vechi moshe haya hagun lilmod tora mippi haggevura? amar leh: vechi moshe atta? amar leh: vechi rabbecha elohim hu? amar rav yosef: shakleh rabbi lematrafseh — dekaamar leh: "rabbecha" vela "rabbi".
Addehachi atya yevama lekammeh derabbi. amar leh rabbi leabbadan: pok bidka. levatar dinfak, amar leh rabbi yishmael, kach amar abba: "ish" katuv bapparasha, aval ishsha — ben gedola ben ketanna.

Amar leh: ta, la tzerichat, kevar hora zaken. kamfassa abbadan veate. amar leh rabbi yishmael berabbi yose: mi shetztzarich lo am kadosh, yefassea al rashe am kadosh. mi sheen tzarich lo am kadosh, heach yefassea al rashe am kadosh?

Amar leh rabbi leabbadan: kum beduchetich! tana: beotah shaa nitztara abbadan, vetavu shene vanav, umeanu shete challotav. amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: berich rachamana dechassefeh leabbadan behay alma.
Amar rabbi amme: middevarav shel berabbi nilmod: ketanna choletzet bifutut. rava amar: ad shettaggia leonat nedarim. vehilcheta: ad shettavi shete searot.
Chaltza bishnayim vechulei. amar rav yosef bar minyome amar rav nachman: en halacha keoto hazzug. veha amar rav nachman chada zimna. deamar rav yosef bar minyome amar rav nachman: chalitza bishlosha!

Tzerichi, dei ittemar hach kammayyta, hava amena: hane mille lechattechilla, aval diavad — afillu tere, ka mashma lan: en halacha keoto hazzug. vei ashmoinan en halacha keoto hazzug, ella ketanna kamma, hava amena: diavad, aval lechattechilla live chamishsha, tzericha.
Maase shechaltzu kulei. beno levenah mi yadana? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: veedim roin oto mibbachutz.

Ibbaya lehu: maase shechaltzu beno levenah abbaray, uva maase lifne rabbi akiva bevet haasurin, o dilma: maase shechaltzu beno levenah bevet haasurin? amar rav yehuda amar rav: bevet haasurin haya maase, ulevet haasurin ba maase.

a: Tanu rabbanan: chalitza muteet — keshera. e zo hi chalitza muteet? amar resh lakish: kol sheomrim lo: chalotz, uvechach atta konsah.

Amar leh rabbi yochanan, ani shone: ben shennitkavvevn hu velo nitkavvevna hi, ben shennitkavvevna hi velo nitkavvevn hu — chalitzatah pesula, ad sheyyitkavvevnu shenehem keechad. veat amrat chalitzatah keshera?!

Ella kol sheomrim lo: "chalotz lah al menat shettitten lecha matayim zuz". tanya name hachi: chalitza muteet — keshera. e zo hi chalitza muteet — kol sheomrim: chalotz lah al menat shettitten lecha matayim zuz.
Umaase beishsha achat shennafla lifne yavam sheen hagun lah, veamru lo: "chalotz lah al menat shettitten lecha matayim zuz", uva maase lifne rabbi chiyyay vehichshirah.
Hahu daata lekammeh derabbi chiyyay bar abba. amar la: bitti, amodi! amara leh: ema yeshivatah zo hi amidatah. amar la: yadat leh? amara leh: in, mamona hu dachaza la vekave lemechleh minna.

Amar la: la nicha lach? amara leh: la. amar leh: chalotz lah, uvechach atta konsah. levatar dachalatz la, amar leh: hasheta, minnach ippasla la, chalotz la chalitza meallayyta, ki hechi detishtere lealma.

Bat chamu, derav pappa nafla lifne yavam sheen hagun lah. ata lekammeh deabbaye, amar leh: chalotz lah, uvechach atta konsah. amar leh rav pappa: la savar la mar leha deamar rabbi yochanan? veella hechi ema leh?
Amar leh: chalotz lah al menat shettitten lecha matayim zuz. levatar dachalatz la, amar la: zil hav leh. amar leh: meshatta ani bach avada leh.
Mi la tanya: hare shehaya boreach mibbet haasurin, vehayta maboret lefanav, vaamar leh: tol dinar vehaavireni — en lo ella secharo.
Alma amar leh meshatte ani bach — hacha name, meshatta ani bach.
Amar leh: avuch hecha? amar leh: bemata. immach hecha? amar leh: bemata. yehav behu eneh (ushechivan).

Tanu rabbanan: chalitza muteet — keshera. get mutee — pasul. chalitza meusset — pesula. get meusse — kasher. hechi dame? i deamar "rotze ani" — afillu chalitza name, vei la amar "rotze ani" — get name la.
Hachi kaamar: chalitza muteet leolam kasher, veget mutee leolam pasul. chalitza meusset veget meusse — zimnin kasher vezimnin pasul. ha deamar "rotze ani", ha dela amar "rotze ani".

Detanya: "yakriv oto" — melammed shekkofin oto. yachol beal korcho — talmud lomar: "lirtzono". ha ketzad? kofin oto ad sheyyomar "rotze ani". vechen atta motze begitte nashim, kofin oto ad sheyyomar "rotze ani".
Amar rava amar rav sechora amar rav huna: choltzin af al pi sheen makkirin, memaanin af al pi sheen makkirin.
Lefichach en kotvin get chalitza ella im ken makkirin, veen kotvin get meun ella im ken makkirin, dechayyshinan levet din toin.

Verava dideh omer: en choltzin ella im ken makkirin, veen memaanin ella im ken makkirin. lefichach kotvin get chalitza af al pi sheen makkirin, vechotvin get meun af al pi sheen makkirin, vela chayyshinan levet din toin.
b: Mishna mitzvat chalitza: ba hu vivimto levet din, vehen massiin lo etza hahogenet lo, shenneemar: "vekaru lo zikne iro vedibberu elav",

Vehi omeret: "meen yevami lehakim leachiv shem beyisrael lo ava yabbemi", vehu omer: "lo chafatzti lekachtah". uvilshon hakkodesh hayu omrim. "veniggesha yevimto elav leene hazzekenim vechaltza naalo meal raglo veyarka befanav", rok hannire laddayyaynim. "veanta veamra kacha yease laish asher lo yivne et bet achiv". ad kan hayu makrin.

Ucheshehikra rabbi hurekanos tachat haela bichfar etam, vegamar et kol happarasha, huchezku lihyot gomrin kol happarasha. "venikra shemo beyisrael bet chalutz hannaal". mitzva baddayyaynin, velo mitzva battalmidim. rabbi yehuda omer: mitzva al kol haomdim sham lomar "chalutz hannaal".
Gemara amar rav yehuda, mitzvat chalitza: kora vekore, vecholetzet verokeket vekora. may kamashma lan? matnitin hi! ha kamashma lan mitzva hachi, vei afech, let lan ba.
Tanya name hachi: ben shehikdim chalitza lirkika, uven shehikdim rekika lachalitza — ma sheasa asuy.
Amar abbaye: hay man demakre get chalitza, la laykre ledida "lo" lechodeh veava yabbemi" lechodeh, demashma: "ava yabbemi". ella: "lo ava yabbemi".
Vela laykre ledideh "lo" lechodeh "chafatzti" lechodeh, demashma "chafatzti lekachtah", ella "lo chafatzti lekachtah". rava amar: afsoke milleta hi, veafsoke milleta let lan ba.
Rav ashe ashkecheh lerav kahana dekamitztaar umakre la "lo ava yabbemi", amar leh: la savar leh mar leha derava?

Amar leh: mode rava belo ava yabbemi". amar abbaye: hay man dechatev gitta dachalitzta — lichtov hachi: akrenuha ledida min "meen yevami" ad "ava yabbemi", veakrenohi ledideh min "lo" ad "lekachtah", veakrenuha ledida min "kacha" vead "chalutz hannaal".
Mar zutera mesartet vechatev lechulla parasha. matkef la mar bar idi: veha lo nittan likkatev! vehilcheta kevoteh demar zutera.

Amar abbaye: rakka ukelatattu haruach — lo asta velo kelum. may tama — "veyarka befanav" baenan. hilkach, hu aroch vehi gutza, kelatathu haruach — ikka "befanav". hi arukka vehu gutz — baenan ad demate lahade appeh vahadar azel.

Amar rava: achala tuma verakat, achala gargishta verakato — lo asta velo kelum. may tama — "veyarka" meatzmah baenan, velekka. veamar rava: tzerichi dayyayne lemichze rukka ki nafek mippumma divama. dichtiv: "leene hazzekenim ... veyarka".

"Venikra shemo beyisrael bet chalutz hannaal" — mitzva baddayyaynin velo battalmidim. tanya, amar rabbi yehuda: paam achat hayinu yoshvim lifne rabbi tarfon, uvata yevama lachlotz, veamar lanu, anu kullechem: "chalutz hannaal", "chalutz hannaal", "chalutz hannaal".
Hadaran alach mitzvat chalitza

a: Bet shammay omrim: en memaanin ella arusot, uvet hillel omrim: arusot unesuot.
Bet shammay omrim: babbaal velo bayyavam, uvet hillel omrim: babbaal uvayyavam.
Bet shammay omrim: befanav, uvet hillel omrim: befanav veshello befanav. bet shammay omrim: bevet din. uvet hillel omrim: bevet din veshello bevet din.
Amru lahem bet hillel levet shammay: memaenet vehi ketanna, afillu arba vechamesh peamim. amru lahem bet shammay: en benot yisrael hefker, ella memaenet umamtenet ad shettagdil, utemaen, vetinnase.
Gemara amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: may tama devet shammay — lefi sheen tenay benissuin. vei nesua temaen, ate lememar yesh tenay benissuin.
Nichnesa lechuppa velo nivala, may ikka lememar? lefi sheen tenay bechuppa.
Masar haav lishluche habbaal, may ikka lememar? la pelug rabbanan.
Uvet hillel: midda yadi denissue ketanna derabbanan ninhu. rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayyhu: tama devet shammay, lefi sheen adam ose beilato beilat zenut.

Nichnesa lachuppa velo nivala, may ikka lememar? la nicha leh detihve chuppa deissura. masar haav lishluche habbaal may ikka lememar? la pelug rabbanan. uvet hillel, kevan deikka kiddushin uchetubba — la atu lememar divilato beilat zenut.

Rav pappa amar: tama devet shammay mishshum pere, tama devet hillel mishshum pere. tama devet shammay mishshum pere — dei amrat nesua temaen, shamet veachel lehu minna, desof sof lemippak kayyma. uvet hillel: adderabba, kevan deamrat temaen — ashboche mashbach lehu. savar dei la, ayytzi la keroveh, umappeki la minneh.
Rava amar: hayeynu tama devet shammay — sheen adam toreach bisuda umafsidah. uvet hillel: tarvayyhu nicha lehu, kede delippok alayyhu kala deishut.

Bet shammay omrim babbaal vechulei. amar rabbi oshaya: memaenet lemaamaro, veenah memaenet lezikkato. amar rav chisda: may tama derabbi oshaya? maamar, demiddata — matzya akra. zikka, dival kurcha — la matzya akra.
Vahare bia, dival kurcha,
b: Umatzya akra! ella: bia umaamar, dehu kaaved — matzya akra. zikka, derachamana rema ala — la matzya akra. ulla amar: memaenet af lezikkato. may tama — nissue kammae ka akra.

Etiveh rava leulla: kol sheyyechola lemaen velo meana — tzaratah choletzet velo mityaybemet. veammay? temaen hasheta vetikerinhu lenissue kammae, vetityaybem tzaratah! tzarat erva shane. detane rame bar yechezkel: meana babbaal — mutteret leaviv. bayyavam — asura leaviv.
Alma bishat nefila niret kechallato, hacha name bishat nefila niret ketzarat bitto.
Amar rav: meana baze — asura laze, midde dehave abbaalat hagget. baalat hagget, lav kevan deittasra la lechad, ittasra lehu lechullehu — hacha name la shena.

Ushemuel amar: meana baze — mutteret laze, vela damya levaalat hagget. baalat hagget, hu deka aved ba. hacha, hi kaavda beh, deamra: "la raena bach, vela tzavena bach". bach hu dela raena, ha bechavrach raena.

Rav assi amar: meana baze — mutteret afillu lo. lema kerabbi oshaya sevira leh, deamar: enah memaenet lezikkato. bechad yavam hachi name dematzya akra. hacha, bishne yevamin asikinan, deen meun lachatzi zikka.
Ki ata ravin, amar rabbi yochanan: meana baze — mutteret laachin, velo hodu lo. man lo hodu lo? amar abbaye: rav. rava amar: rabbi oshaya. veamri la rav assi.

Bet shammay omrim: befanav vechulei. tanya, amru lahen bet hillel levet shammay: vahalo pishon haggammal meana ishto shello befanav! amru lahen bet shammay levet hillel: pishon haggammal bemidda kefusha madad, lefichach maddu lo bemidda kefusha.
Middeka achel pere, peshita nesua hi. vehaamri bet shammay nesua la memaana! tere kitre avadu beh.

Bet shammay omrim: bifne bet din vechulei. tenan hatam: hachalitza vehammeunin bishlosha. man tanna? amar rabba: bet shammay hi. abbaye amar: afillu tema bet hillel, ad kan la kaamri bet hillel ella dela baenan mumechin, aval shelosha baenan.

Kidtanya, bet shammay omrim: bifne bet din, uvet hillel omrim: bifne bet din veshello bifne bet din. veellu veellu modim shetztzarich shelosha. rabbi yose bar yehuda verabbi elazar berabbi shimon machshirin bishnayim. amar rav yosef bar minyome amar rav nachman: halacha keoto hazzug.
Bet shammay omrim: temaen vechulei. veha meana chada zimna! amar shemuel: ad shettagdil vetomar: "rotza ani bammeunim harishonim".
Ulla amar, tarte katane: o shettemaen vetagdil veteares, o shettemaen vetinnase lealtar.
Bishlama ulla, hayeynu dekatane "ad shettagdil vetinnase". ella lishmuel "ad shettagdil vetomar" mibbee leh! kashya.

Mishna e zo hi ketanna shetztzericha lemaen — kol shehissiuha immah veacheha ledatah. hissiuha shello ledatah — enah tzericha lemaen. rabbi chanina ben antignos omer: kol tinoket sheenah yechola lishmor kiddusheha — enah tzericha lemaen.
Rabbi elazar omer: en maase ketanna kelum, ella kimfutta. bat yisrael lechohen — lo tochal bitruma, bat kohen leyisrael — tochal bitruma.
Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: kol akkava shehi min haish — keillu hi ishto. kol akkava sheenah min haish — keillu enah ishto.
